text_en: In the eighth month, in the second year of King Darius, the word of the Lord came to Zacharias the son of Barachias, the son of Addo, the prophet , saying:
text_la: In mense octavo, in anno secundo Darii regis, factum est verbum Domini ad Zachariam filium Barachiæ filii Addo prophetam, dicens:
text_pt: No oitavo mês do segundo ano de Dario veio a palavra do SENHOR ao profeta Zacarias, filho de Baraquias, filho de Ido, dizendo:
text_el: ἐν τῷ ὀγδόῳ μηνὶ ἔτους δευτέρου ἐπὶ Δαρείου ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρὸς Ζαχαριαν τὸν τοῦ Βαραχιου υἱὸν Αδδω τὸν προφήτην λέγων

text_en: The Lord has been exceeding angry with your fathers.
text_la: Iratus est Dominus super patres vestros iracundia.
text_pt: O Senhor se irou fortemente contra vossos pais.
text_el: ὠργίσθη κύριος ἐπὶ τοὺς πατέρας ὑμῶν ὀργὴν μεγάλην

text_en: And you shall say to them: Thus says the Lord of hosts : Turn to me, says the Lord of hosts : and I will turn to you, says the Lord of hosts .
text_la: Et dices ad eos : Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : Convertimini ad me, ait Dominus exercituum, et convertar ad vos, dicit Dominus exercituum.
text_pt: Portanto dize-lhes: Assim diz o Senhor dos Exércitos: Tornai-vos para mim, diz o Senhor dos Exércitos, e eu me tornarei para vós, diz o Senhor dos Exércitos.
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτούς τάδε λέγει κύριος παντοκράτωρ ἐπιστρέψατε πρός με καὶ ἐπιστραφήσομαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς λέγει κύριος

text_en: Be not as your fathers, to whom the former prophets have cried, saying: Thus says the Lord of hosts : Turn from your evil ways, and from your wicked thoughts: but they did not give ear, neither did they hearken to me, says the Lord .
text_la: Ne sitis sicut patres vestri, ad quos clamabant prophetæ priores, dicentes : Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : Convertimini de viis vestris malis, et de cogitationibus vestris pessimis : et non audierunt, neque attenderunt ad me, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: E não sejais como vossos pais, aos quais clamavam os primeiros profetas, dizendo: Assim diz o Senhor dos Exércitos: Convertei-vos agora dos vossos maus caminhos e das vossas más obras; mas não ouviram, nem me escutaram, diz o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ μὴ γίνεσθε καθὼς οἱ πατέρες ὑμῶν οἷς ἐνεκάλεσαν αὐτοῖς οἱ προφῆται οἱ ἔμπροσθεν λέγοντες τάδε λέγει κύριος παντοκράτωρ ἀποστρέψατε ἀπὸ τῶν ὁδῶν ὑμῶν τῶν πονηρῶν καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν ἐπιτηδευμάτων ὑμῶν τῶν πονηρῶν καὶ οὐ προσέσχον τοῦ εἰσακοῦσαί μου λέγει κύριος

text_en: Your fathers, where are they? And the prophets , shall they live always?
text_la: Patres vestri, ubi sunt? et prophetæ numquid in sempiternum vivent?
text_pt: Vossos pais, onde estão? E os profetas, viverão eles para sempre?
text_el: οἱ πατέρες ὑμῶν ποῦ εἰσιν καὶ οἱ προφῆται μὴ τὸν αἰῶνα ζήσονται

text_en: But yet my words, and my ordinances, which I gave in charge to my servants the prophets , did they not take hold of your fathers, and they returned, and said: As the Lord of hosts thought to do to us according to our ways, and according to our devices, so he has done to us.
text_la: Verumtamen verba mea, et legitima mea, quæ mandavi servis meis prophetis, numquid non comprehenderunt patres vestros, et conversi sunt, et dixerunt : Sicut cogitavit Dominus exercituum facere nobis secundum vias nostras, et secundum adinventiones nostras, fecit nobis?
text_pt: Contudo as minhas palavras e os meus estatutos, que eu ordenei aos profetas, meus servos, não alcançaram a vossos pais? E eles voltaram, e disseram: Assim como o Senhor dos Exércitos fez tenção de nos tratar, segundo os nossos caminhos, e segundo as nossas obras, assim ele nos tratou.
text_el: πλὴν τοὺς λόγους μου καὶ τὰ νόμιμά μου δέχεσθε ὅσα ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαι ἐν πνεύματί μου τοῖς δούλοις μου τοῖς προφήταις οἳ κατελάβοσαν τοὺς πατέρας ὑμῶν καὶ ἀπεκρίθησαν καὶ εἶπαν καθὼς παρατέτακται κύριος παντοκράτωρ τοῦ ποιῆσαι κατὰ τὰς ὁδοὺς ὑμῶν καὶ κατὰ τὰ ἐπιτηδεύματα ὑμῶν οὕτως ἐποίησεν ὑμῖν

text_en: In the four and twentieth day of the eleventh month which is called Sabath, in the second year of Darius, the word of the Lord came to Zacharias the son of Barachias, the son of Addo, the prophet , saying:
text_la: In die vigesima et quarta undecimi mensis Sabath, in anno secundo Darii, factum est verbum Domini ad Zachariam filium Barachiæ filii Addo prophetam, dicens:
text_pt: Aos vinte e quatro dias do mês undécimo (que é o mês de Sebate), no segundo ano de Dario, veio a palavra do Senhor ao profeta Zacarias, filho de Baraquias, filho de Ido, dizendo:
text_el: τῇ τετράδι καὶ εἰκάδι τῷ ἑνδεκάτῳ μηνί οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ μὴν Σαβατ ἐν τῷ δευτέρῳ ἔτει ἐπὶ Δαρείου ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρὸς Ζαχαριαν τὸν τοῦ Βαραχιου υἱὸν Αδδω τὸν προφήτην λέγων

text_en: I saw by night, and behold a man riding upon a red horse, and he stood among the myrtle trees, that were in the bottom: and behind him were horses, red, speckled, and white.
text_la: Vidi per noctem, et ecce vir ascendens super equum rufum, et ipse stabat inter myrteta, quæ erant in profundo, et post eum equi rufi, varii, et albi.
text_pt: Olhei de noite, e vi um homem montado num cavalo vermelho; e ele estava parado entre as murtas que estavam na baixada; e atrás dele estavam cavalos vermelhos, malhados e brancos.
text_el: ἑώρακα τὴν νύκτα καὶ ἰδοὺ ἀνὴρ ἐπιβεβηκὼς ἐπὶ ἵππον πυρρόν καὶ οὗτος εἱστήκει ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν δύο ὀρέων τῶν κατασκίων καὶ ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ ἵπποι πυρροὶ καὶ ψαροὶ καὶ ποικίλοι καὶ λευκοί

text_en: And I said: What are these, my lord? And the angel that spoke in me, said to me: I will show you what these are:
text_la: Et dixi : Quid sunt isti, domine mi? Et dixit ad me angelus qui loquebatur in me : Ego ostendam tibi quid sint hæc.
text_pt: E eu disse: Senhor meu, quem são estes? E disse-me o anjo que falava comigo: Eu te mostrarei quem são estes.
text_el: καὶ εἶπα τί οὗτοι κύριε καὶ εἶπεν πρός με ὁ ἄγγελος ὁ λαλῶν ἐν ἐμοί ἐγὼ δείξω σοι τί ἐστιν ταῦτα

text_en: And the man that stood among the myrtle trees answered, and said: These are they, whom the Lord has sent to walk through the earth.
text_la: Et respondit vir qui stabat inter myrteta, et dixit : Isti sunt quos misit Dominus ut perambulent terram.
text_pt: Então respondeu o homem que estava entre as murtas, e disse: Estes são os que o Senhor tem enviado para percorrerem a terra.
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθη ὁ ἀνὴρ ὁ ἐφεστηκὼς ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν ὀρέων καὶ εἶπεν πρός με οὗτοί εἰσιν οὓς ἐξαπέσταλκεν κύριος τοῦ περιοδεῦσαι τὴν γῆν

text_en: And they answered the angel of the Lord , that stood among the myrtle trees, and said: We have walked through the earth, and behold all the earth is inhabited, and is at rest.
text_la: Et responderunt angelo Domini, qui stabat inter myrteta, et dixerunt : Perambulavimus terram, et ecce omnis terra habitatur, et quiescit.
text_pt: E eles responderam ao anjo do Senhor, que estava entre as murtas, e disseram: Nós já percorremos a terra, e eis que toda a terra está tranqüila e quieta.
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθησαν τῷ ἀγγέλῳ κυρίου τῷ ἐφεστῶτι ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν ὀρέων καὶ εἶπον περιωδεύκαμεν πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν καὶ ἰδοὺ πᾶσα ἡ γῆ κατοικεῖται καὶ ἡσυχάζει

text_en: And the angel of the Lord answered, and said: O Lord of hosts , how long will you not have mercy on Jerusalem , and on the cities of Juda , with which you have been angry ? This is now the seventieth year.
text_la: Et respondit angelus Domini, et dixit : Domine exercituum, usquequo tu non misereberis Jerusalem, et urbium Juda, quibus iratus es? iste jam septuagesimus annus est.
text_pt: Então o anjo do Senhor respondeu, e disse: Ó Senhor dos Exércitos, até quando não terás compaixão de Jerusalém, e das cidades de Judá, contra as quais estiveste irado estes setenta anos?
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθη ὁ ἄγγελος κυρίου καὶ εἶπεν κύριε παντοκράτωρ ἕως τίνος οὐ μὴ ἐλεήσῃς τὴν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ τὰς πόλεις Ιουδα ἃς ὑπερεῖδες τοῦτο ἑβδομηκοστὸν ἔτος

text_en: And the Lord answered the angel , that spoke in me, good words, comfortable words.
text_la: Et respondit Dominus angelo qui loquebatur in me verba bona, verba consolatoria.
text_pt: E respondeu o Senhor ao anjo, que falava comigo, com palavras boas, palavras consoladoras.
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθη κύριος παντοκράτωρ τῷ ἀγγέλῳ τῷ λαλοῦντι ἐν ἐμοὶ ῥήματα καλὰ καὶ λόγους παρακλητικούς

text_en: And the angel that spoke in me, said to me: Cry, saying: Thus says the Lord of hosts : I am zealous for Jerusalem , and Sion with a great zeal .
text_la: Et dixit ad me angelus qui loquebatur in me : Clama, dicens : Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : Zelatus sum Jerusalem et Sion zelo magno,
text_pt: E o anjo que falava comigo disse-me: Clama, dizendo: Assim diz o Senhor dos Exércitos: Com grande zelo estou zelando por Jerusalém e por Sião.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρός με ὁ ἄγγελος ὁ λαλῶν ἐν ἐμοί ἀνάκραγε λέγων τάδε λέγει κύριος παντοκράτωρ ἐζήλωκα τὴν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ τὴν Σιων ζῆλον μέγαν

text_en: And I am angry with a great anger with the wealthy nations: for I was angry a little, but they helped forward the evil .
text_la: et ira magna ego irascor super gentes opulentas, quia ego iratus sum parum, ipsi vero adjuverunt in malum.
text_pt: E com grande indignação estou irado contra os gentios em descanso; porque eu estava pouco indignado, mas eles agravaram o mal.
text_el: καὶ ὀργὴν μεγάλην ἐγὼ ὀργίζομαι ἐπὶ τὰ ἔθνη τὰ συνεπιτιθέμενα ἀνθ' ὧν ἐγὼ μὲν ὠργίσθην ὀλίγα αὐτοὶ δὲ συνεπέθεντο εἰς κακά

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord : I will return to Jerusalem in mercies: my house shall be built in it, says the Lord of hosts : and the building line shall be stretched forth upon Jerusalem .
text_la: Propterea hæc dicit Dominus : Revertar ad Jerusalem in misericordiis, et domus mea ædificabitur in ea, ait Dominus exercituum, et perpendiculum extendetur super Jerusalem.
text_pt: Portanto, assim diz o Senhor: Voltei-me para Jerusalém com misericórdia; nela será edificada a minha casa, diz o Senhor dos Exércitos, e o cordel será estendido sobre Jerusalém:
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει κύριος ἐπιστρέψω ἐπὶ Ιερουσαλημ ἐν οἰκτιρμῷ καὶ ὁ οἶκός μου ἀνοικοδομηθήσεται ἐν αὐτῇ λέγει κύριος παντοκράτωρ καὶ μέτρον ἐκταθήσεται ἐπὶ Ιερουσαλημ ἔτι

text_en: Cry yet, saying: Thus says the Lord of hosts : My cities shall yet flow with good things: and the Lord will yet comfort Sion, and he will yet choose Jerusalem .
text_la: Adhuc clama, dicens : Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : Adhuc affluent civitates meæ bonis, et consolabitur adhuc Dominus Sion, et eliget adhuc Jerusalem.
text_pt: Clama outra vez, dizendo: Assim diz o Senhor dos Exércitos: As minhas cidades ainda aumentarão e prosperarão; porque o Senhor ainda consolará a Sião e ainda escolherá a Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρός με ὁ ἄγγελος ὁ λαλῶν ἐν ἐμοί ἀνάκραγε λέγων τάδε λέγει κύριος παντοκράτωρ ἔτι διαχυθήσονται πόλεις ἐν ἀγαθοῖς καὶ ἐλεήσει κύριος ἔτι τὴν Σιων καὶ αἱρετιεῖ ἔτι τὴν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: And I lifted up my eyes, and saw: and behold four horns.
text_la: Et levavi oculos meos, et vidi, et ecce quatuor cornua.
text_pt: Tornei a levantar os meus olhos, e vi, e eis um homem que tinha na mão um cordel de medir.
text_el: καὶ ἦρα τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς μου καὶ εἶδον καὶ ἰδοὺ τέσσαρα κέρατα

text_en: And I said to the angel that spoke in me: What are these? And he said to me: These are the horns that have scattered Juda , and Israel , and Jerusalem .
text_la: Et dixi ad angelum qui loquebatur in me : Quid sunt hæc? Et dixit ad me : Hæc sunt cornua quæ ventilaverunt Judam, et Israël, et Jerusalem.
text_pt: E eu disse: Para onde vais tu? E ele me disse: Vou medir Jerusalém, para ver qual é a sua largura e qual o seu comprimento.
text_el: καὶ εἶπα πρὸς τὸν ἄγγελον τὸν λαλοῦντα ἐν ἐμοί τί ἐστιν ταῦτα κύριε καὶ εἶπεν πρός με ταῦτα τὰ κέρατα τὰ διασκορπίσαντα τὸν Ιουδαν καὶ τὸν Ισραηλ

text_en: And the Lord showed me four smiths.
text_la: Et ostendit mihi Dominus quatuor fabros.
text_pt: E eis que saiu o anjo que falava comigo, e outro anjo lhe saiu ao encontro.
text_el: καὶ ἔδειξέν μοι κύριος τέσσαρας τέκτονας

text_en: And I said: What come these to do? And he spoke, saying: These are the horns which have scattered Juda every man apart, and none of them lifted up his head: and these have come to fray them, to cast down the horns of the nations, that have lifted up the horn upon the land of Juda to scatter it.
text_la: Et dixi : Quid isti veniunt facere? Qui ait, dicens : Hæc sunt cornua quæ ventilaverunt Judam per singulos viros, et nemo eorum levavit caput suum : et venerunt isti deterrere ea, ut dejiciant cornua gentium, quæ levaverunt cornu super terram Juda ut dispergerent eam.
text_pt: E disse-lhe: Corre, fala a este jovem, dizendo: Jerusalém será habitada como as aldeias sem muros, por causa da multidão dos homens e dos animais que haverá nela.
text_el: καὶ εἶπα τί οὗτοι ἔρχονται ποιῆσαι καὶ εἶπεν πρός με ταῦτα τὰ κέρατα τὰ διασκορπίσαντα τὸν Ιουδαν καὶ τὸν Ισραηλ κατέαξαν καὶ οὐδεὶς αὐτῶν ἦρεν κεφαλήν καὶ εἰσῆλθον οὗτοι τοῦ ὀξῦναι αὐτὰ εἰς χεῖρας αὐτῶν τὰ τέσσαρα κέρατα τὰ ἔθνη τὰ ἐπαιρόμενα κέρας ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν κυρίου τοῦ διασκορπίσαι αὐτήν

text_en: And I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold a man , with a measuring line in his hand.
text_la: Et levavi oculos meos, et vidi, et ecce vir, et in manu ejus funiculus mensorum.
text_pt: Pois eu, diz o Senhor, serei para ela um muro de fogo em redor, e para glória estarei no meio dela.
text_el: καὶ ἦρα τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς μου καὶ εἶδον καὶ ἰδοὺ ἀνὴρ καὶ ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ σχοινίον γεωμετρικόν

text_en: And I said: Where are you going? And he said to me: To measure Jerusalem , and to see how great is the breadth thereof, and how great the length thereof.
text_la: Et dixi : Quo tu vadis? Et dixit ad me : Ut metiar Jerusalem, et videam quanta sit latitudo ejus, et quanta longitudo ejus.
text_pt: Ah, ah! Fugi agora da terra do norte, diz o Senhor, porque vos espalhei pelos quatro ventos do céu, diz o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ εἶπα πρὸς αὐτόν ποῦ σὺ πορεύῃ καὶ εἶπεν πρός με διαμετρῆσαι τὴν Ιερουσαλημ τοῦ ἰδεῖν πηλίκον τὸ πλάτος αὐτῆς ἐστιν καὶ πηλίκον τὸ μῆκος

text_en: And behold the angel that spoke in me went forth, and another angel went out to meet him.
text_la: Et ecce angelus qui loquebatur in me egrediebatur, et angelus alius egrediebatur in occursum ejus:
text_pt: Ah! Sião! Escapa, tu, que habitas com a filha de babilônia.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ ὁ ἄγγελος ὁ λαλῶν ἐν ἐμοὶ εἱστήκει καὶ ἄγγελος ἕτερος ἐξεπορεύετο εἰς συνάντησιν αὐτῷ

text_en: And he said to him: Run, speak to this young man, saying: Jerusalem shall be inhabited without walls, by reason of the multitude of men , and of the beasts in the midst thereof.
text_la: et dixit ad eum : Curre, loquere ad puerum istum, dicens : Absque muro habitabitur Jerusalem, præ multitudine hominum et jumentorum in medio ejus.
text_pt: Porque assim diz o Senhor dos Exércitos: Depois da glória ele me enviou às nações que vos despojaram; porque aquele que tocar em vós toca na menina do seu olho.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτὸν λέγων δράμε καὶ λάλησον πρὸς τὸν νεανίαν ἐκεῖνον λέγων κατακάρπως κατοικηθήσεται Ιερουσαλημ ἀπὸ πλήθους ἀνθρώπων καὶ κτηνῶν ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς

text_en: And I will be to it, says the Lord , a wall of fire round about: and I will be in glory in the midst thereof.
text_la: Et ego ero ei, ait Dominus, murus ignis in circuitu, et in gloria ero in medio ejus.
text_pt: Porque eis aí levantarei a minha mão sobre eles, e eles virão a ser a presa daqueles que os serviram; assim sabereis vós que o Senhor dos Exércitos me enviou.
text_el: καὶ ἐγὼ ἔσομαι αὐτῇ λέγει κύριος τεῖχος πυρὸς κυκλόθεν καὶ εἰς δόξαν ἔσομαι ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς

text_en: O, O flee out of the land of the north, says the Lord , for I have scattered you into the four winds of heaven , says the Lord .
text_la: O, o, fugite de terra aquilonis, dicit Dominus, quoniam in quatuor ventos cæli dispersi vos, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: Exulta, e alegra-te ó filha de Sião, porque eis que venho, e habitarei no meio de ti, diz o Senhor.
text_el: ὦ ὦ φεύγετε ἀπὸ γῆς βορρᾶ λέγει κύριος διότι ἐκ τῶν τεσσάρων ἀνέμων τοῦ οὐρανοῦ συνάξω ὑμᾶς λέγει κύριος

text_en: O Sion, flee, you that dwell with the daughter of Babylon :
text_la: O Sion! fuge, quæ habitas apud filiam Babylonis :
text_pt: E naquele dia muitas nações se ajuntarão ao Senhor, e serão o meu povo, e habitarei no meio de ti e saberás que o Senhor dos Exércitos me enviou a ti.
text_el: εἰς Σιων ἀνασῴζεσθε οἱ κατοικοῦντες θυγατέρα Βαβυλῶνος

text_en: For thus says the Lord of hosts : After the glory he has sent me to the nations that have robbed you: for he that touches you, touches the apple of my eye:
text_la: quia hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : Post gloriam misit me ad gentes quæ spoliaverunt vos : qui enim tetigerit vos, tangit pupillam oculi mei :
text_pt: Então o Senhor herdará a Judá como sua porção na terra santa, e ainda escolherá a Jerusalém.
text_el: διότι τάδε λέγει κύριος παντοκράτωρ ὀπίσω δόξης ἀπέσταλκέν με ἐπὶ τὰ ἔθνη τὰ σκυλεύσαντα ὑμᾶς διότι ὁ ἁπτόμενος ὑμῶν ὡς ἁπτόμενος τῆς κόρης τοῦ ὀφθαλμοῦ αὐτοῦ

text_en: For behold, I lift up my hand upon them, and they shall be a prey to those that served them: and you shall know that the Lord of hosts sent me.
text_la: quia ecce ego levo manum meam super eos, et erunt prædæ his qui serviebant sibi : et cognoscetis quia Dominus exercituum misit me.
text_pt: Cala-te, toda a carne, diante do Senhor, porque ele se levantou da sua santa morada.
text_el: διότι ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐπιφέρω τὴν χεῖρά μου ἐπ' αὐτούς καὶ ἔσονται σκῦλα τοῖς δουλεύουσιν αὐτοῖς καὶ γνώσεσθε διότι κύριος παντοκράτωρ ἀπέσταλκέν με

text_en: Sing praise, and rejoice, O daughter of Sion: for behold I come, and I will dwell in the midst of you: says the Lord .
text_la: Lauda et lætare, filia Sion, quia ecce ego venio, et habitabo in medio tui, ait Dominus.
text_el: τέρπου καὶ εὐφραίνου θύγατερ Σιων διότι ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἔρχομαι καὶ κατασκηνώσω ἐν μέσῳ σου λέγει κύριος

text_en: And many nations shall be joined to the Lord in that day, and they shall be my people, and I will dwell in the midst of you: and you shall know that the Lord of hosts has sent me to you.
text_la: Et applicabuntur gentes multæ ad Dominum in die illa, et erunt mihi in populum, et habitabo in medio tui : et scies quia Dominus exercituum misit me ad te.
text_el: καὶ καταφεύξονται ἔθνη πολλὰ ἐπὶ τὸν κύριον ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ καὶ ἔσονται αὐτῷ εἰς λαὸν καὶ κατασκηνώσουσιν ἐν μέσῳ σου καὶ ἐπιγνώσῃ ὅτι κύριος παντοκράτωρ ἐξαπέσταλκέν με πρὸς σέ

text_en: And the Lord shall possess Juda his portion in the sanctified land: and he shall yet choose Jerusalem .
text_la: Et possidebit Dominus Judam partem suam in terra sanctificata, et eliget adhuc Jerusalem.
text_el: καὶ κατακληρονομήσει κύριος τὸν Ιουδαν τὴν μερίδα αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν τὴν ἁγίαν καὶ αἱρετιεῖ ἔτι τὴν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: Let all flesh be silent at the presence of the Lord : for he is risen up out of his holy habitation.
text_la: Sileat omnis caro a facie Domini, quia consurrexit de habitaculo sancto suo.
text_el: εὐλαβείσθω πᾶσα σὰρξ ἀπὸ προσώπου κυρίου διότι ἐξεγήγερται ἐκ νεφελῶν ἁγίων αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the Lord showed me Jesus the high priest standing before the angel of the Lord : and Satan stood on his right hand to be his adversary.
text_la: Et ostendit mihi Dominus Jesum sacerdotem magnum, stantem coram angelo Domini : et Satan stabat a dextris ejus ut adversaretur ei.
text_pt: E ele mostrou-me o sumo sacerdote Josué, o qual estava diante do anjo do SENHOR, e Satanás estava à sua mão direita, para se lhe opor.
text_el: καὶ ἔδειξέν μοι Ἰησοῦν τὸν ἱερέα τὸν μέγαν ἑστῶτα πρὸ προσώπου ἀγγέλου κυρίου καὶ ὁ διάβολος εἱστήκει ἐκ δεξιῶν αὐτοῦ τοῦ ἀντικεῖσθαι αὐτῷ

text_en: And the Lord said to Satan : The Lord rebuke you, O Satan : and the Lord that chose Jerusalem rebuke you: Is not this a brand plucked out of the fire?
text_la: Et dixit Dominus ad Satan : Increpet Dominus in te, Satan! et increpet Dominus in te, qui elegit Jerusalem! numquid non iste torris est erutus de igne?
text_pt: Mas o Senhor disse a Satanás: O Senhor te repreenda, ó Satanás, sim, o Senhor, que escolheu Jerusalém, te repreenda; não é este um tição tirado do fogo?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς τὸν διάβολον ἐπιτιμήσαι κύριος ἐν σοί διάβολε καὶ ἐπιτιμήσαι κύριος ἐν σοὶ ὁ ἐκλεξάμενος τὴν Ιερουσαλημ οὐκ ἰδοὺ τοῦτο ὡς δαλὸς ἐξεσπασμένος ἐκ πυρός

text_en: And Jesus was clothed with filthy garments: and he stood before the face of the angel .
text_la: Et Jesus erat indutus vestibus sordidis, et stabat ante faciem angeli.
text_pt: Josué, vestido de vestes sujas, estava diante do anjo.
text_el: καὶ Ἰησοῦς ἦν ἐνδεδυμένος ἱμάτια ῥυπαρὰ καὶ εἱστήκει πρὸ προσώπου τοῦ ἀγγέλου

text_en: Who answered, and said to them that stood before him, saying: Take away the filthy garments from him. And he said to him: Behold I have taken away your iniquity , and have clothed you with change of garments.
text_la: Qui respondit, et ait ad eos qui stabant coram se, dicens : Auferte vestimenta sordida ab eo. Et dixit ad eum : Ecce abstuli a te iniquitatem tuam, et indui te mutatoriis.
text_pt: Então respondeu, aos que estavam diante dele, dizendo: Tirai-lhe estas vestes sujas. E a Josué disse: Eis que tenho feito com que passe de ti a tua iniqüidade, e te vestirei de vestes finas.
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθη καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς τοὺς ἑστηκότας πρὸ προσώπου αὐτοῦ λέγων ἀφέλετε τὰ ἱμάτια τὰ ῥυπαρὰ ἀπ' αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν ἰδοὺ ἀφῄρηκα τὰς ἀνομίας σου καὶ ἐνδύσατε αὐτὸν ποδήρη

text_en: And he said: Put a clean mitre upon his head: and they put a clean mitre upon his head, and clothed him with garments, and the angel of the Lord stood.
text_la: Et dixit : Ponite cidarim mundam super caput ejus. Et posuerunt cidarim mundam super caput ejus, et induerunt eum vestibus : et angelus Domini stabat.
text_pt: E disse eu: Ponham-lhe uma mitra limpa sobre a sua cabeça. E puseram uma mitra limpa sobre a sua cabeça, e vestiram-no das roupas; e o anjo do Senhor estava em pé.
text_el: καὶ ἐπίθετε κίδαριν καθαρὰν ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ περιέβαλον αὐτὸν ἱμάτια καὶ ἐπέθηκαν κίδαριν καθαρὰν ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ ὁ ἄγγελος κυρίου εἱστήκει

text_en: And the angel of the Lord protested to Jesus, saying:
text_la: Et contestabatur angelus Domini Jesum, dicens:
text_pt: E o anjo do Senhor protestou a Josué, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ διεμαρτύρατο ὁ ἄγγελος κυρίου πρὸς Ἰησοῦν λέγων

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts : If you will walk in my ways, and keep my charge, you also shall judge my house, and shall keep my courts , and I will give you some of them that are now present here to walk with you.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : Si in viis meis ambulaveris, et custodiam meam custodieris, tu quoque judicabis domum meam, et custodies atria mea, et dabo tibi ambulantes de his qui nunc hic assistunt.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor dos Exércitos: Se andares nos meus caminhos, e se observares a minha ordenança, também tu julgarás a minha casa, e também guardarás os meus átrios, e te darei livre acesso entre os que estão aqui.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος παντοκράτωρ ἐὰν ἐν ταῖς ὁδοῖς μου πορεύῃ καὶ ἐὰν τὰ προστάγματά μου φυλάξῃς καὶ σὺ διακρινεῖς τὸν οἶκόν μου καὶ ἐὰν διαφυλάξῃς καί γε τὴν αὐλήν μου καὶ δώσω σοι ἀναστρεφομένους ἐν μέσῳ τῶν ἑστηκότων τούτων

text_en: Hear, O Jesus you high priest , you and your friends that dwell before you, for they are portending men : for behold, I WILL BRING MY SERVANT THE ORIENT.
text_la: Audi, Jesu sacerdos magne, tu et amici tui, qui habitant coram te, quia viri portendentes sunt : ecce enim ego adducam servum meum Orientem.
text_pt: Ouve, pois, Josué, sumo sacerdote, tu e os teus companheiros que se assentam diante de ti, porque são homens portentosos; eis que eu farei vir o meu servo, o RENOVO.
text_el: ἄκουε δή Ἰησοῦ ὁ ἱερεὺς ὁ μέγας σὺ καὶ οἱ πλησίον σου οἱ καθήμενοι πρὸ προσώπου σου διότι ἄνδρες τερατοσκόποι εἰσί διότι ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἄγω τὸν δοῦλόν μου Ἀνατολήν

text_en: For behold the stone that I have laid before Jesus: upon one stone there are seven eyes: behold I will grave the graving thereof, says the Lord of hosts : and I will take away the iniquity of that land in one day.
text_la: Quia ecce lapis quem dedi coram Jesu : super lapidem unum septem oculi sunt : ecce ego cælabo sculpturam ejus, ait Dominus exercituum, et auferam iniquitatem terræ illius in die una.
text_pt: Porque eis aqui a pedra que pus diante de Josué; sobre esta pedra única estão sete olhos; eis que eu esculpirei a sua escultura, diz o Senhor dos Exércitos, e tirarei a iniqüidade desta terra num só dia.
text_el: διότι ὁ λίθος ὃν ἔδωκα πρὸ προσώπου Ἰησοῦ ἐπὶ τὸν λίθον τὸν ἕνα ἑπτὰ ὀφθαλμοί εἰσιν ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ὀρύσσω βόθρον λέγει κύριος παντοκράτωρ καὶ ψηλαφήσω πᾶσαν τὴν ἀδικίαν τῆς γῆς ἐκείνης ἐν ἡμέρᾳ μιᾷ

text_en: In that day, says the Lord of hosts , every man shall call his friend under the vine and under the fig tree.
text_la: In die illa, dicit Dominus exercituum, vocabit vir amicum suum subter vitem et subter ficum.
text_pt: Naquele dia, diz o Senhor dos Exércitos, cada um de vós convidará o seu próximo para debaixo da videira e para debaixo da figueira.
text_el: ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ λέγει κύριος παντοκράτωρ συγκαλέσετε ἕκαστος τὸν πλησίον αὐτοῦ ὑποκάτω ἀμπέλου καὶ ὑποκάτω συκῆς

text_en: And the angel that spoke in me came again: and he waked me, as a man that is wakened out of his sleep.
text_la: Et reversus est angelus qui loquebatur in me, et suscitavit me quasi virum qui suscitatur de somno suo.
text_pt: E o anjo que falava comigo voltou, e despertou-me, como a um homem que é despertado do seu sono,
text_el: καὶ ἐπέστρεψεν ὁ ἄγγελος ὁ λαλῶν ἐν ἐμοὶ καὶ ἐξήγειρέν με ὃν τρόπον ὅταν ἐξεγερθῇ ἄνθρωπος ἐξ ὕπνου αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he said to me: What do you see? And I said: I have looked, and behold a candlestick all of gold, and its lamp upon the top of it: and the seven lights thereof upon it: and seven funnels for the lights that were upon the top thereof.
text_la: Et dixit ad me : Quid tu vides? Et dixi : Vidi, et ecce candelabrum aureum totum, et lampas ejus super caput ipsius, et septem lucernæ ejus super illud, et septem infusoria lucernis quæ erant super caput ejus.
text_pt: E disse-me: Que vês? E eu disse: Olho, e eis que vejo um castiçal todo de ouro, e um vaso de azeite no seu topo, com as suas sete lâmpadas; e sete canudos, um para cada uma das lâmpadas que estão no seu topo.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρός με τί σύ βλέπεις καὶ εἶπα ἑώρακα καὶ ἰδοὺ λυχνία χρυσῆ ὅλη καὶ τὸ λαμπάδιον ἐπάνω αὐτῆς καὶ ἑπτὰ λύχνοι ἐπάνω αὐτῆς καὶ ἑπτὰ ἐπαρυστρίδες τοῖς λύχνοις τοῖς ἐπάνω αὐτῆς

text_en: And two olive trees over it: one upon the right side of the lamp, and the other upon the left side thereof.
text_la: Et duæ olivæ super illud : una a dextris lampadis, et una a sinistris ejus.
text_pt: E, por cima dele, duas oliveiras, uma à direita do vaso de azeite, e outra à sua esquerda.
text_el: καὶ δύο ἐλαῖαι ἐπάνω αὐτῆς μία ἐκ δεξιῶν τοῦ λαμπαδίου καὶ μία ἐξ εὐωνύμων

text_en: And I answered, and said to the angel that spoke in me, saying: What are these things, my lord?
text_la: Et respondi, et aio ad angelum qui loquebatur in me, dicens : Quid sunt hæc, domine mi?
text_pt: E respondi, dizendo ao anjo que falava comigo: Senhor meu, que é isto?
text_el: καὶ ἐπηρώτησα καὶ εἶπον πρὸς τὸν ἄγγελον τὸν λαλοῦντα ἐν ἐμοὶ λέγων τί ἐστιν ταῦτα κύριε

text_en: And the angel that spoke in me answered, and said to me: Do you know not what these things are? And I said: No, my lord.
text_la: Et respondit angelus qui loquebatur in me, et dixit ad me : Numquid nescis quid sunt hæc? Et dixi : Non, domine mi.
text_pt: Então respondeu o anjo que falava comigo, dizendo-me: Não sabes tu o que é isto? E eu disse: Não, senhor meu.
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθη ὁ ἄγγελος ὁ λαλῶν ἐν ἐμοὶ καὶ εἶπεν πρός με οὐ γινώσκεις τί ἐστιν ταῦτα καὶ εἶπα οὐχί κύριε

text_en: And he answered, and spoke to me, saying: This is the word of the Lord to Zorobabel, saying: Not with an army, nor by might, but by my spirit, says the Lord of hosts .
text_la: Et respondit, et ait ad me, dicens : Hoc est verbum Domini ad Zorobabel, dicens : Non in exercitu, nec in robore, sed in spiritu meo, dicit Dominus exercituum.
text_pt: E respondeu-me, dizendo: Esta é a palavra do Senhor a Zorobabel, dizendo: Não por força nem por violência, mas sim pelo meu Espírito, diz o Senhor dos Exércitos.
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθη καὶ εἶπεν πρός με λέγων οὗτος ὁ λόγος κυρίου πρὸς Ζοροβαβελ λέγων οὐκ ἐν δυνάμει μεγάλῃ οὐδὲ ἐν ἰσχύι ἀλλ' ἢ ἐν πνεύματί μου λέγει κύριος παντοκράτωρ

text_en: Who are you, O great mountain, before Zorobabel? You shall become a plain: and he shall bring out the chief stone, and shall give equal grace to the grace thereof.
text_la: Quis tu, mons magne, coram Zorobabel? In planum : et educet lapidem primarium, et exæquabit gratiam gratiæ ejus.
text_pt: Quem és tu, ó grande monte? Diante de Zorobabel tornar-te-ás uma campina; porque ele trará a pedra angular com aclamações: Graça, graça a ela.
text_el: τίς εἶ σύ τὸ ὄρος τὸ μέγα πρὸ προσώπου Ζοροβαβελ τοῦ κατορθῶσαι καὶ ἐξοίσω τὸν λίθον τῆς κληρονομίας ἰσότητα χάριτος χάριτα αὐτῆς

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: E a palavra do Senhor veio novamente a mim, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: The hands of Zorobabel have laid the foundations of this house, and his hands shall finish it: and you shall know that the Lord of hosts has sent me to you.
text_la: Manus Zorobabel fundaverunt domum istam, et manus ejus perficient eam : et scietis quia Dominus exercituum misit me ad vos.
text_pt: As mãos de Zorobabel têm lançado os alicerces desta casa; também as suas mãos a acabarão, para que saibais que o Senhor dos Exércitos me enviou a vós.
text_el: αἱ χεῖρες Ζοροβαβελ ἐθεμελίωσαν τὸν οἶκον τοῦτον καὶ αἱ χεῖρες αὐτοῦ ἐπιτελέσουσιν αὐτόν καὶ ἐπιγνώσῃ διότι κύριος παντοκράτωρ ἐξαπέσταλκέν με πρὸς σέ

text_en: For who has despised little days? And they shall rejoice, and shall see the tin plummet in the hand of Zorobabel. These are the seven eyes of the Lord , that run to and fro through the whole earth.
text_la: Quis enim despexit dies parvos? Et lætabuntur, et videbunt lapidem stanneum in manu Zorobabel. Septem isti oculi sunt Domini, qui discurrunt in universam terram.
text_pt: Porque, quem despreza o dia das coisas pequenas? Pois esses se alegrarão, vendo o prumo na mão de Zorobabel; esses são os sete olhos do Senhor, que percorrem por toda a terra.
text_el: διότι τίς ἐξουδένωσεν εἰς ἡμέρας μικράς καὶ χαροῦνται καὶ ὄψονται τὸν λίθον τὸν κασσιτέρινον ἐν χειρὶ Ζοροβαβελ ἑπτὰ οὗτοι ὀφθαλμοὶ κυρίου εἰσὶν οἱ ἐπιβλέποντες ἐπὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν

text_en: And I answered, and said to him: What are these two olive trees upon the right side of the candlestick, and upon the left side thereof?
text_la: Et respondi, et dixi ad eum : Quid sunt duæ olivæ istæ, ad dexteram candelabri, et ad sinistram ejus?
text_pt: Respondi mais, dizendo-lhe: Que são as duas oliveiras à direita e à esquerda do castiçal?
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθην καὶ εἶπα πρὸς αὐτόν τί αἱ δύο ἐλαῖαι αὗται αἱ ἐκ δεξιῶν τῆς λυχνίας καὶ ἐξ εὐωνύμων

text_en: And I answered again, and said to him: What are the two olive branches, that are by the two golden beaks, in which are the funnels of gold?
text_la: Et respondi secundo, et dixi ad eum : Quid sunt duæ spicæ olivarum quæ sunt juxta duo rostra aurea in quibus sunt suffusoria ex auro?
text_pt: E, respondendo-lhe outra vez, disse: Que são aqueles dois ramos de oliveira, que estão junto aos dois tubos de ouro, e que vertem de si azeite dourado?
text_el: καὶ ἐπηρώτησα ἐκ δευτέρου καὶ εἶπα πρὸς αὐτόν τί οἱ δύο κλάδοι τῶν ἐλαιῶν οἱ ἐν ταῖς χερσὶν τῶν δύο μυξωτήρων τῶν χρυσῶν τῶν ἐπιχεόντων καὶ ἐπαναγόντων τὰς ἐπαρυστρίδας τὰς χρυσᾶς

text_en: And he spoke to me, saying: Do you not know what these are? And I said: No, my lord.
text_la: Et ait ad me, dicens : Numquid nescis quid sunt hæc? Et dixi : Non, domine mi.
text_pt: E ele me falou, dizendo: Não sabes tu o que é isto? E eu disse: Não, senhor meu.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρός με οὐκ οἶδας τί ἐστιν ταῦτα καὶ εἶπα οὐχί κύριε

text_en: And he said: These are two sons of oil who stand before the Lord of the whole earth.
text_la: Et dixit : Isti sunt duo filii olei, qui assistunt Dominatori universæ terræ.
text_pt: Então ele disse: Estes são os dois ungidos, que estão diante do Senhor de toda a terra.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν οὗτοι οἱ δύο υἱοὶ τῆς πιότητος παρεστήκασιν τῷ κυρίῳ πάσης τῆς γῆς

text_en: And I turned and lifted up my eyes: and I saw, and behold a volume flying.
text_la: Et conversus sum, et levavi oculos meos, et vidi, et ecce volumen volans.
text_pt: E outra vez levantei os meus olhos, e vi, e eis um rolo volante.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέστρεψα καὶ ἦρα τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς μου καὶ εἶδον καὶ ἰδοὺ δρέπανον πετόμενον

text_en: And he said to me: What do you see? And I said: I see a volume flying: the length thereof is twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof ten cubits.
text_la: Et dixit ad me : Quid tu vides? Et dixi : Ego video volumen volans : longitudo ejus viginti cubitorum, et latitudo ejus decem cubitorum.
text_pt: E disse-me o anjo: Que vês? E eu disse: Vejo um rolo volante, que tem vinte côvados de comprido e dez côvados de largo.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρός με τί σὺ βλέπεις καὶ εἶπα ἐγὼ ὁρῶ δρέπανον πετόμενον μῆκος πήχεων εἴκοσι καὶ πλάτος πήχεων δέκα

text_en: And he said to me: This is the curse that goes forth over the face of the earth: for every thief shall be judged as is there written: and every one that swears in like manner shall be judged by it.
text_la: Et dixit ad me : Hæc est maledictio quæ egreditur super faciem omnis terræ : quia omnis fur, sicut ibi scriptum est, judicabitur, et omnis jurans ex hoc similiter judicabitur.
text_pt: Então disse-me: Esta é a maldição que sairá pela face de toda a terra; porque qualquer que furtar será desarraigado, conforme está estabelecido de um lado do rolo; como também qualquer que jurar falsamente, será desarraigado, conforme está estabelecido do outro lado do rolo.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρός με αὕτη ἡ ἀρὰ ἡ ἐκπορευομένη ἐπὶ πρόσωπον πάσης τῆς γῆς διότι πᾶς ὁ κλέπτης ἐκ τούτου ἕως θανάτου ἐκδικηθήσεται καὶ πᾶς ὁ ἐπίορκος ἐκ τούτου ἕως θανάτου ἐκδικηθήσεται

text_en: I will bring it forth, says the Lord of hosts : and it shall come to the house of the thief , and to the house of him that swears falsely by my name : and it shall remain in the midst of his house, and shall consume it, with the timber thereof, and the stones thereof.
text_la: Educam illud, dicit Dominus exercituum : et veniet ad domum furis, et ad domum jurantis in nomine meo mendaciter : et commorabitur in medio domus ejus, et consumet eam, et ligna ejus, et lapides ejus.
text_pt: Eu a farei sair, disse o Senhor dos Exércitos, e ela entrará na casa do ladrão, e na casa do que jurar falsamente pelo meu nome; e permanecerá no meio da sua casa, e a consumirá juntamente com a sua madeira e com as suas pedras.
text_el: καὶ ἐξοίσω αὐτό λέγει κύριος παντοκράτωρ καὶ εἰσελεύσεται εἰς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ κλέπτου καὶ εἰς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ ὀμνύοντος τῷ ὀνόματί μου ἐπὶ ψεύδει καὶ καταλύσει ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ οἴκου αὐτοῦ καὶ συντελέσει αὐτὸν καὶ τὰ ξύλα αὐτοῦ καὶ τοὺς λίθους αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the angel went forth that spoke in me, and he said to me: Lift up your eyes, and see what this is, that goes forth.
text_la: Et egressus est angelus qui loquebatur in me, et dixit ad me : Leva oculos tuos, et vide quid est hoc quod egreditur.
text_pt: E saiu o anjo, que falava comigo, e disse-me: Levanta agora os teus olhos, e vê que é isto que sai.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ὁ ἄγγελος ὁ λαλῶν ἐν ἐμοὶ καὶ εἶπεν πρός με ἀνάβλεψον τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς σου καὶ ἰδὲ τί τὸ ἐκπορευόμενον τοῦτο

text_en: And I said: What is it? And he said: This is a vessel going forth. And he said: This is their eye in all the earth.
text_la: Et dixi : Quidnam est? Et ait : Hæc est amphora egrediens. Et dixit : Hæc est oculus eorum in universa terra.
text_pt: E eu disse: Que é isto? E ele disse: Isto é um efa que sai. Disse ainda: Este é o aspecto deles em toda a terra.
text_el: καὶ εἶπα τί ἐστιν καὶ εἶπεν τοῦτο τὸ μέτρον τὸ ἐκπορευόμενον καὶ εἶπεν αὕτη ἡ ἀδικία αὐτῶν ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ

text_en: And behold a talent of lead was carried, and behold a woman sitting in the midst of the vessel.
text_la: Et ecce talentum plumbi portabatur, et ecce mulier una sedens in medio amphoræ.
text_pt: E eis que foi levantado um talento de chumbo, e uma mulher estava assentada no meio do efa.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ τάλαντον μολίβου ἐξαιρόμενον καὶ ἰδοὺ μία γυνὴ ἐκάθητο ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ μέτρου

text_en: And he said: This is wickedness . And he cast her into the midst of the vessel, and cast the weight of lead upon the mouth thereof.
text_la: Et dixit : Hæc est impietas. Et projecit eam in medio amphoræ, et misit massam plumbeam in os ejus.
text_pt: E ele disse: Esta é a impiedade. E a lançou dentro do efa; e lançou sobre a boca deste o peso de chumbo.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ ἀνομία καὶ ἔρριψεν αὐτὴν ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ μέτρου καὶ ἔρριψεν τὸν λίθον τοῦ μολίβου εἰς τὸ στόμα αὐτῆς

text_en: And I lifted up my eyes and looked: and behold there came out two women , and wind was in their wings, and they had wings like the wings of a kite: and they lifted up the vessel between the earth and the heaven.
text_la: Et levavi oculos meos, et vidi : et ecce duæ mulieres egredientes : et spiritus in alis earum, et habebant alas quasi alas milvi, et levaverunt amphoram inter terram et cælum.
text_pt: E levantei os meus olhos, e vi, e eis que saíram duas mulheres; e traziam vento nas suas asas, pois tinham asas como as da cegonha; e levantaram o efa entre a terra e o céu.
text_el: καὶ ἦρα τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς μου καὶ εἶδον καὶ ἰδοὺ δύο γυναῖκες ἐκπορευόμεναι καὶ πνεῦμα ἐν ταῖς πτέρυξιν αὐτῶν καὶ αὗται εἶχον πτέρυγας ὡς πτέρυγας ἔποπος καὶ ἀνέλαβον τὸ μέτρον ἀνὰ μέσον τῆς γῆς καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ οὐρανοῦ

text_en: And I said to the angel that spoke in me: Whither do these carry the vessel?
text_la: Et dixi ad angelum qui loquebatur in me : Quo istæ deferunt amphoram?
text_pt: Então eu disse ao anjo que falava comigo: Para onde levam elas o efa?
text_el: καὶ εἶπα πρὸς τὸν ἄγγελον τὸν λαλοῦντα ἐν ἐμοί ποῦ αὗται ἀποφέρουσιν τὸ μέτρον

text_en: And he said to me: That a house may be built for it in the land of Sennaar, and that it may be established, and set there upon its own basis.
text_la: Et dixit ad me : Ut ædificetur ei domus in terra Sennaar, et stabiliatur, et ponatur ibi super basem suam.
text_pt: E ele me disse: Para lhe edificarem uma casa na terra de Sinar; e, estando ela acabada, ele será posto ali na sua base.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρός με οἰκοδομῆσαι αὐτῷ οἰκίαν ἐν γῇ Βαβυλῶνος καὶ ἑτοιμάσαι καὶ θήσουσιν αὐτὸ ἐκεῖ ἐπὶ τὴν ἑτοιμασίαν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And I turned, and lifted up my eyes, and saw: and behold four chariots came out from the midst of two mountains: and the mountains were mountains of brass.
text_la: Et conversus sum, et levavi oculos meos, et vidi : et ecce quatuor quadrigæ egredientes de medio duorum montium : et montes, montes ærei.
text_pt: E outra vez levantei os meus olhos, e vi, e eis que quatro carros saiam dentre dois montes, e estes montes eram montes de bronze.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέστρεψα καὶ ἦρα τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς μου καὶ εἶδον καὶ ἰδοὺ τέσσαρα ἅρματα ἐκπορευόμενα ἐκ μέσου δύο ὀρέων καὶ τὰ ὄρη ἦν ὄρη χαλκᾶ

text_en: In the first chariot were red horses, and in the second chariot black horses.
text_la: In quadriga prima equi rufi, et in quadriga secunda equi nigri,
text_pt: No primeiro carro eram cavalos vermelhos, e no segundo carro, cavalos pretos,
text_el: ἐν τῷ ἅρματι τῷ πρώτῳ ἵπποι πυρροί καὶ ἐν τῷ ἅρματι τῷ δευτέρῳ ἵπποι μέλανες

text_en: And in the third chariot white horses, and in the fourth chariot grisled horses, and strong ones.
text_la: et in quadriga tertia equi albi, et in quadriga quarta equi varii et fortes.
text_pt: E no terceiro carro, cavalos brancos, e no quarto carro, cavalos malhados, todos eram fortes.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τῷ ἅρματι τῷ τρίτῳ ἵπποι λευκοί καὶ ἐν τῷ ἅρματι τῷ τετάρτῳ ἵπποι ποικίλοι ψαροί

text_en: And I answered, and said to the angel that spoke in me: What are these, my lord?
text_la: Et respondi, et dixi ad angelum qui loquebatur in me : Quid sunt hæc, domine mi?
text_pt: E respondi, dizendo ao anjo que falava comigo: Que é isto, senhor meu?
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθην καὶ εἶπα πρὸς τὸν ἄγγελον τὸν λαλοῦντα ἐν ἐμοί τί ἐστιν ταῦτα κύριε

text_en: And the angel answered, and said to me: These are the four winds of the heaven , which go forth to stand before the Lord of all the earth .
text_la: Et respondit angelus, et ait ad me : Isti sunt quatuor venti cæli, qui egrediuntur ut stent coram Dominatore omnis terræ.
text_pt: E o anjo respondeu, dizendo-me: Estes são os quatro espíritos dos céus, saindo donde estavam perante o Senhor de toda a terra.
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθη ὁ ἄγγελος ὁ λαλῶν ἐν ἐμοὶ καὶ εἶπεν ταῦτά ἐστιν οἱ τέσσαρες ἄνεμοι τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἐκπορεύονται παραστῆναι τῷ κυρίῳ πάσης τῆς γῆς

text_en: That in which were the black horses went forth into the land of the north, and the white went forth after them: and the grisled went forth to the land of the south.
text_la: In qua erant equi nigri, egrediebantur in terram aquilonis : et albi egressi sunt post eos, et varii egressi sunt ad terram austri.
text_pt: O carro em que estão os cavalos pretos, sai para a terra do norte, e os brancos saem atrás deles, e os malhados saem para a terra do sul.
text_el: ἐν ᾧ ἦσαν οἱ ἵπποι οἱ μέλανες ἐξεπορεύοντο ἐπὶ γῆν βορρᾶ καὶ οἱ λευκοὶ ἐξεπορεύοντο κατόπισθεν αὐτῶν καὶ οἱ ποικίλοι ἐξεπορεύοντο ἐπὶ γῆν νότου

text_en: And they that were most strong, went out, and sought to go, and to run to and fro through all the earth. And he said: Go, walk throughout the earth: and they walked throughout the earth.
text_la: Qui autem erant robustissimi, exierunt, et quærebant ire et discurrere per omnem terram. Et dixit : Ite, perambulate terram : et perambulaverunt terram.
text_pt: E os cavalos fortes saíam, e procuravam ir por diante, para percorrerem a terra. E ele disse: Ide, percorrei a terra. E percorreram a terra.
text_el: καὶ οἱ ψαροὶ ἐξεπορεύοντο καὶ ἐπέβλεπον τοῦ πορεύεσθαι τοῦ περιοδεῦσαι τὴν γῆν καὶ εἶπεν πορεύεσθε καὶ περιοδεύσατε τὴν γῆν καὶ περιώδευσαν τὴν γῆν

text_en: And he called me, and spoke to me, saying: Behold they that go forth into the land of the north, have quieted my spirit in the land of the north.
text_la: Et vocavit me, et locutus est ad me, dicens : Ecce qui egrediuntur in terram aquilonis, requiescere fecerunt spiritum meum in terra aquilonis.
text_pt: E chamou-me, e falou-me, dizendo: Eis que aqueles que saíram para a terra do norte fizeram repousar o meu Espírito na terra do norte.
text_el: καὶ ἀνεβόησεν καὶ ἐλάλησεν πρός με λέγων ἰδοὺ οἱ ἐκπορευόμενοι ἐπὶ γῆν βορρᾶ ἀνέπαυσαν τὸν θυμόν μου ἐν γῇ βορρᾶ

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens:
text_pt: E a palavra do Senhor veio a mim, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρός με λέγων

text_en: Take of them of the captivity, of Holdai, and of Tobias, and of Idaias; you shall come in that day, and shall go into the house of Josias , the son of Sophonias, who came out of Babylon .
text_la: Sume a transmigratione, ab Holdai, et a Tobia, et ab Idaia : et venies tu in die illa, et intrabis domum Josiæ filii Sophoniæ, qui venerunt de Babylone.
text_pt: Toma dos que foram levados cativos, a saber, de Heldai, de Tobias e de Jedaías, os quais vieram de babilônia, e vem tu no mesmo dia, e entra na casa de Josias, filho de Sofonias.
text_el: λαβὲ τὰ ἐκ τῆς αἰχμαλωσίας παρὰ τῶν ἀρχόντων καὶ παρὰ τῶν χρησίμων αὐτῆς καὶ παρὰ τῶν ἐπεγνωκότων αὐτὴν καὶ εἰσελεύσῃ σὺ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ εἰς τὸν οἶκον Ιωσιου τοῦ Σοφονιου τοῦ ἥκοντος ἐκ Βαβυλῶνος

text_en: And you shall take gold and silver: and shall make crowns, and you shall set them on the head of Jesus the son of Josedec, the high priest .
text_la: Et sumes aurum et argentum, et facies coronas, et pones in capite Jesu filii Josedec, sacerdotis magni:
text_pt: Toma, digo, prata e ouro, e faze coroas, e põe-nas na cabeça do sumo sacerdote Josué, filho de Jozadaque.
text_el: καὶ λήψῃ ἀργύριον καὶ χρυσίον καὶ ποιήσεις στεφάνους καὶ ἐπιθήσεις ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν Ἰησοῦ τοῦ Ιωσεδεκ τοῦ ἱερέως τοῦ μεγάλου

text_en: And you shall speak to him, saying: Thus says the Lord of hosts , saying: BEHOLD A MAN, THE ORIENT IS HIS NAME: and under him shall he spring up, and shall build a temple to the Lord .
text_la: et loqueris ad eum, dicens : Hæc ait Dominus exercituum, dicens : Ecce vir, Oriens nomen ejus, et subter eum orietur, et ædificabit templum Domino.
text_pt: E fala-lhe, dizendo: Assim diz o SENHOR dos Exércitos: Eis aqui o homem cujo nome é RENOVO; ele brotará do seu lugar, e edificará o templo do SENHOR.
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτόν τάδε λέγει κύριος παντοκράτωρ ἰδοὺ ἀνήρ Ἀνατολὴ ὄνομα αὐτῷ καὶ ὑποκάτωθεν αὐτοῦ ἀνατελεῖ καὶ οἰκοδομήσει τὸν οἶκον κυρίου

text_en: Yea, he shall build a temple to the Lord : and he shall bear the glory , and shall sit, and rule upon his throne: and he shall be a priest upon his throne, and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.
text_la: Et ipse exstruet templum Domino : et ipse portabit gloriam, et sedebit, et dominabitur super solio suo : et erit sacerdos super solio suo, et consilium pacis erit inter illos duos.
text_pt: Ele mesmo edificará o templo do Senhor, e ele levará a glória; assentar-se-á no seu trono e dominará, e será sacerdote no seu trono, e conselho de paz haverá entre ambos os ofícios.
text_el: καὶ αὐτὸς λήμψεται ἀρετὴν καὶ καθίεται καὶ κατάρξει ἐπὶ τοῦ θρόνου αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔσται ὁ ἱερεὺς ἐκ δεξιῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ βουλὴ εἰρηνικὴ ἔσται ἀνὰ μέσον ἀμφοτέρων

text_en: And the crowns shall be to Helem, and Tobias, and Idaias, and to Hem, the son of Sophonias, a memorial in the temple of the Lord .
text_la: Et coronæ erunt Helem, et Tobiæ, et Idaiæ, et Hem filio Sophoniæ, memoriale in templo Domini.
text_pt: E estas coroas serão para Helém, e para Tobias, e para Jedaías, e para Hem, filho de Sofonias, como um memorial no templo do Senhor.
text_el: ὁ δὲ στέφανος ἔσται τοῖς ὑπομένουσιν καὶ τοῖς χρησίμοις αὐτῆς καὶ τοῖς ἐπεγνωκόσιν αὐτὴν καὶ εἰς χάριτα υἱοῦ Σοφονιου καὶ εἰς ψαλμὸν ἐν οἴκῳ κυρίου

text_en: And they that are far off, shall come and shall build in the temple of the Lord : and you shall know that the Lord of hosts sent me to you. But this shall come to pass, if hearing you will hear the voice of the Lord your God .
text_la: Et qui procul sunt, venient, et ædificabunt in templo Domini : et scietis quia Dominus exercituum misit me ad vos. Erit autem hoc, si auditu audieritis vocem Domini Dei vestri.
text_pt: E aqueles que estão longe virão, e edificarão no templo do Senhor, e vós sabereis que o Senhor dos Exércitos me tem enviado a vós; e isto sucederá assim, se diligentemente ouvirdes a voz do Senhor vosso Deus.
text_el: καὶ οἱ μακρὰν ἀπ' αὐτῶν ἥξουσιν καὶ οἰκοδομήσουσιν ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ κυρίου καὶ γνώσεσθε διότι κύριος παντοκράτωρ ἀπέσταλκέν με πρὸς ὑμᾶς καὶ ἔσται ἐὰν εἰσακούοντες εἰσακούσητε τῆς φωνῆς κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ὑμῶν

text_en: And it came to pass in the fourth year of King Darius, that the word of the Lord came to Zacharias, in the fourth day of the ninth month, which is Casleu.
text_la: Et factum est in anno quarto Darii regis, factum est verbum Domini ad Zachariam, in quarta mensis noni, qui est Casleu.
text_pt: Aconteceu, no quarto ano do rei Dario, que a palavra do SENHOR veio a Zacarias, no quarto dia do nono mês, que é Quisleu.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ τετάρτῳ ἔτει ἐπὶ Δαρείου τοῦ βασιλέως ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρὸς Ζαχαριαν τετράδι τοῦ μηνὸς τοῦ ἐνάτου ὅς ἐστιν Χασελευ

text_en: When Sarasar, and Rogommelech, and the men that were with him, sent to the house of God , to entreat the face of the Lord :
text_la: Et miserunt ad domum Dei Sarasar et Rogommelech, et viri qui erant cum eo, ad deprecandam faciem Domini:
text_pt: Quando o povo enviou Sarezer e Régen-Meleque, e os seus homens, à casa de Deus, para suplicarem o favor do Senhor,
text_el: καὶ ἐξαπέστειλεν εἰς Βαιθηλ Σαρασαρ καὶ Αρβεσεερ ὁ βασιλεὺς καὶ οἱ ἄνδρες αὐτοῦ τοῦ ἐξιλάσασθαι τὸν κύριον

text_en: To speak to the priests of the house of the Lord of hosts , and to the prophets , saying: Must I weep in the fifth month, or must I sanctify myself as I have now done for many years?
text_la: ut dicerent sacerdotibus domus Domini exercituum, et prophetis, loquentes : Numquid flendum est mihi in quinto mense, vel sanctificare me debeo, sicut jam feci multis annis?
text_pt: E para dizerem aos sacerdotes, que estavam na casa do Senhor dos Exércitos, e aos profetas: Chorarei eu no quinto mês, fazendo abstinência, como tenho feito por tantos anos?
text_el: λέγων πρὸς τοὺς ἱερεῖς τοὺς ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ κυρίου παντοκράτορος καὶ πρὸς τοὺς προφήτας λέγων εἰσελήλυθεν ὧδε ἐν τῷ μηνὶ τῷ πέμπτῳ τὸ ἁγίασμα καθότι ἐποίησα ἤδη ἱκανὰ ἔτη

text_en: And the word of the Lord of hosts came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factum est verbum Domini exercituum ad me, dicens:
text_pt: Então a palavra do Senhor dos Exércitos veio a mim, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου τῶν δυνάμεων πρός με λέγων

text_en: Speak to all the people of the land, and to the priests , saying: When you fasted , and mourned in the fifth and the seventh month for these seventy years: did you keep a fast unto me?
text_la: Loquere ad omnem populum terræ, et ad sacerdotes, dicens : Cum jejunaretis, et plangeretis in quinto et septimo per hos septuaginta annos, numquid jejunium jejunastis mihi?
text_pt: Fala a todo o povo desta terra, e aos sacerdotes, dizendo: Quando jejuastes, e pranteastes, no quinto e no sétimo mês, durante estes setenta anos, porventura, foi mesmo para mim que jejuastes?
text_el: εἰπὸν πρὸς ἅπαντα τὸν λαὸν τῆς γῆς καὶ πρὸς τοὺς ἱερεῖς λέγων ἐὰν νηστεύσητε ἢ κόψησθε ἐν ταῖς πέμπταις ἢ ἐν ταῖς ἑβδόμαις καὶ ἰδοὺ ἑβδομήκοντα ἔτη μὴ νηστείαν νενηστεύκατέ μοι

text_en: And when you ate and drank, did you not eat for yourselves, and drink for yourselves?
text_la: et cum comedistis et bibistis, numquid non vobis comedistis et vobismetipsis bibistis?
text_pt: Ou quando comestes, e quando bebestes, não foi para vós mesmos que comestes e bebestes?
text_el: καὶ ἐὰν φάγητε ἢ πίητε οὐχ ὑμεῖς ἔσθετε καὶ ὑμεῖς πίνετε

text_en: Are not these the words which the Lord spoke by the hand of the former prophets , when Jerusalem as yet was inhabited, and was wealthy , both itself and the cities round about it, and there were inhabitants towards the south, and in the plain?
text_la: numquid non sunt verba quæ locutus est Dominus in manu prophetarum priorum, cum adhuc Jerusalem habitaretur ut esset opulenta, ipsa et urbes in circuitu ejus, et ad austrum, et in campestribus habitaretur?
text_pt: Não foram estas as palavras que o Senhor pregou pelo ministério dos primeiros profetas, quando Jerusalém estava habitada e em paz, com as suas cidades ao redor dela, e o sul e a campina eram habitados?
text_el: οὐχ οὗτοι οἱ λόγοι εἰσίν οὓς ἐλάλησεν κύριος ἐν χερσὶν τῶν προφητῶν τῶν ἔμπροσθεν ὅτε ἦν Ιερουσαλημ κατοικουμένη καὶ εὐθηνοῦσα καὶ αἱ πόλεις αὐτῆς κυκλόθεν καὶ ἡ ὀρεινὴ καὶ ἡ πεδινὴ κατῳκεῖτο

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to Zacharias, saying:
text_la: Et factum est verbum Domini ad Zachariam, dicens:
text_pt: E a palavra do Senhor veio a Zacarias, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρὸς Ζαχαριαν λέγων

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts , saying: Judge true judgment, and show mercy and compassion every man to his brother.
text_la: Hæc ait Dominus exercituum, dicens : Judicium verum judicate, et misericordiam et miserationes facite, unusquisque cum fratre suo.
text_pt: Assim falou o Senhor dos Exércitos, dizendo: Executai juízo verdadeiro, mostrai piedade e misericórdia cada um para com seu irmão.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος παντοκράτωρ κρίμα δίκαιον κρίνατε καὶ ἔλεος καὶ οἰκτιρμὸν ποιεῖτε ἕκαστος πρὸς τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And oppress not the widow , and the fatherless , and the stranger, and the poor: and let not a man devise evil in his heart against his brother.
text_la: Et viduam, et pupillum, et advenam, et pauperem nolite calumniari : et malum vir fratri suo non cogitet in corde suo.
text_pt: E não oprimais a viúva, nem o órfão, nem o estrangeiro, nem o pobre, nem intente cada um, em seu coração, o mal contra o seu irmão.
text_el: καὶ χήραν καὶ ὀρφανὸν καὶ προσήλυτον καὶ πένητα μὴ καταδυναστεύετε καὶ κακίαν ἕκαστος τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ μὴ μνησικακείτω ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ὑμῶν

text_en: But they would not hearken, and they turned away the shoulder to depart: and they stopped their ears, not to hear.
text_la: Et noluerunt attendere, et averterunt scapulam recedentem, et aures suas aggravaverunt ne audirent.
text_pt: Eles, porém, não quiseram escutar, e deram-me o ombro rebelde, e ensurdeceram os seus ouvidos, para que não ouvissem.
text_el: καὶ ἠπείθησαν τοῦ προσέχειν καὶ ἔδωκαν νῶτον παραφρονοῦντα καὶ τὰ ὦτα αὐτῶν ἐβάρυναν τοῦ μὴ εἰσακούειν

text_en: And they made their heart as the adamant stone, lest they should hear the law, and the words which the Lord of hosts sent in his spirit by the hand of the former prophets : so a great indignation came from the Lord of hosts .
text_la: Et cor suum posuerunt ut adamantem, ne audirent legem, et verba quæ misit Dominus exercituum in spiritu suo per manum prophetarum priorum : et facta est indignatio magna a Domino exercituum.
text_pt: Sim, fizeram os seus corações como pedra de diamante, para que não ouvissem a lei, nem as palavras que o Senhor dos Exércitos enviara pelo seu Espírito por intermédio dos primeiros profetas; daí veio a grande ira do Senhor dos Exércitos.
text_el: καὶ τὴν καρδίαν αὐτῶν ἔταξαν ἀπειθῆ τοῦ μὴ εἰσακούειν τοῦ νόμου μου καὶ τοὺς λόγους οὓς ἐξαπέστειλεν κύριος παντοκράτωρ ἐν πνεύματι αὐτοῦ ἐν χερσὶν τῶν προφητῶν τῶν ἔμπροσθεν καὶ ἐγένετο ὀργὴ μεγάλη παρὰ κυρίου παντοκράτορος

text_en: And it came to pass that as he spoke, and they heard not: so shall they cry, and I will not hear, says the Lord of hosts .
text_la: Et factum est sicut locutus est, et non audierunt : sic clamabunt et non exaudiam, dicit Dominus exercituum.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, assim como ele clamou e eles não ouviram, também eles clamaram, e eu não ouvi, diz o Senhor dos Exércitos.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ὃν τρόπον εἶπεν καὶ οὐκ εἰσήκουσαν αὐτοῦ οὕτως κεκράξονται καὶ οὐ μὴ εἰσακούσω λέγει κύριος παντοκράτωρ

text_en: And I dispersed them throughout all kingdoms, which they know not: and the land was left desolate behind them, so that no man passed through or returned: and they changed the delightful land into a wilderness .
text_la: Et dispersi eos per omnia regna quæ nesciunt : et terra desolata est ab eis, eo quod non esset transiens et revertens : et posuerunt terram desiderabilem in desertum.
text_pt: Assim os espalhei com um turbilhão por entre todas as nações, que eles não conheceram, e a terra foi assolada atrás deles, de sorte que ninguém passava por ela, nem se voltava; porque fizeram da terra desejada uma desolação.
text_el: καὶ ἐκβαλῶ αὐτοὺς εἰς πάντα τὰ ἔθνη ἃ οὐκ ἔγνωσαν καὶ ἡ γῆ ἀφανισθήσεται κατόπισθεν αὐτῶν ἐκ διοδεύοντος καὶ ἐξ ἀναστρέφοντος καὶ ἔταξαν γῆν ἐκλεκτὴν εἰς ἀφανισμόν

text_en: And the word of the Lord of hosts came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factum est verbum Domini exercituum, dicens:
text_pt: Depois veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR dos Exércitos, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου παντοκράτορος λέγων

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts : I have been jealous for Sion with a great jealousy , and with a great indignation have I been jealous for her.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : Zelatus sum Sion zelo magno, et indignatione magna zelatus sum eam.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor dos Exércitos: Zelei por Sião com grande zelo, e com grande indignação zelei por ela.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος παντοκράτωρ ἐζήλωσα τὴν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ τὴν Σιων ζῆλον μέγαν καὶ θυμῷ μεγάλῳ ἐζήλωσα αὐτήν

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts : I am returned to Sion, and I will dwell in the midst of Jerusalem : and Jerusalem shall be called The city of truth , and the mountain of the Lord of hosts , The sanctified mountain.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : Reversus sum ad Sion, et habitabo in medio Jerusalem : et vocabitur Jerusalem civitas veritatis, et mons Domini exercituum mons sanctificatus.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor: Voltarei para Sião, e habitarei no meio de Jerusalém; e Jerusalém chamar-se-á a cidade da verdade, e o monte do Senhor dos Exércitos, o monte santo.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος καὶ ἐπιστρέψω ἐπὶ Σιων καὶ κατασκηνώσω ἐν μέσῳ Ιερουσαλημ καὶ κληθήσεται ἡ Ιερουσαλημ πόλις ἡ ἀληθινὴ καὶ τὸ ὄρος κυρίου παντοκράτορος ὄρος ἅγιον

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts : There shall yet old men and old women dwell in the streets of Jerusalem : and every man with his staff in his hand through multitude of days.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : Adhuc habitabunt senes et anus in plateis Jerusalem, et viri baculus in manu ejus præ multitudine dierum.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor dos Exércitos: Ainda nas praças de Jerusalém habitarão velhos e velhas; levando cada um, na mão, o seu bordão, por causa da sua muita idade.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος παντοκράτωρ ἔτι καθήσονται πρεσβύτεροι καὶ πρεσβύτεραι ἐν ταῖς πλατείαις Ιερουσαλημ ἕκαστος τὴν ῥάβδον αὐτοῦ ἔχων ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ πλήθους ἡμερῶν

text_en: And the streets of the city shall be full of boys and girls, playing in the streets thereof.
text_la: Et plateæ civitatis complebuntur infantibus et puellis, ludentibus in plateis ejus.
text_pt: E as ruas da cidade se encherão de meninos e meninas, que nelas brincarão.
text_el: καὶ αἱ πλατεῖαι τῆς πόλεως πλησθήσονται παιδαρίων καὶ κορασίων παιζόντων ἐν ταῖς πλατείαις αὐτῆς

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts : If it seem hard in the eyes of the remnant of this people in those days: shall it be hard in my eyes, says the Lord of hosts ?
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : Si videbitur difficile in oculis reliquiarum populi hujus in diebus illis, numquid in oculis meis difficile erit? dicit Dominus exercituum.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor dos Exércitos: Se isto for maravilhoso aos olhos do restante deste povo naqueles dias, será também maravilhoso aos meus olhos? diz o Senhor dos Exércitos.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος παντοκράτωρ διότι εἰ ἀδυνατήσει ἐνώπιον τῶν καταλοίπων τοῦ λαοῦ τούτου ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις μὴ καὶ ἐνώπιον ἐμοῦ ἀδυνατήσει λέγει κύριος παντοκράτωρ

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts : Behold I will save my people from the land of the east, and from the land of the going down of the sun.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum: Ecce ego salvabo populum meum de terra orientis et de terra occasus solis.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor dos Exércitos: Eis que salvarei o meu povo da terra do oriente e da terra do ocidente;
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος παντοκράτωρ ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἀνασῴζω τὸν λαόν μου ἀπὸ γῆς ἀνατολῶν καὶ ἀπὸ γῆς δυσμῶν

text_en: And I will bring them, and they shall dwell in the midst of Jerusalem : and they shall be my people, and I will be their God in truth and in justice .
text_la: Et adducam eos, et habitabunt in medio Jerusalem : et erunt mihi in populum, et ego ero eis in Deum, in veritate et in justitia.
text_pt: E trá-los-ei, e habitarão no meio de Jerusalém; e eles serão o meu povo, e eu lhes serei o seu Deus em verdade e em justiça.
text_el: καὶ εἰσάξω αὐτοὺς καὶ κατασκηνώσω ἐν μέσῳ Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἔσονταί μοι εἰς λαόν καὶ ἐγὼ ἔσομαι αὐτοῖς εἰς θεὸν ἐν ἀληθείᾳ καὶ ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts : Let your hands be strengthened, you that hear in these days these words by the mouth of the prophets , in the day that the house of the Lord of hosts was founded, that the temple might be built.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : Confortentur manus vestræ, qui auditis in his diebus sermones istos per os prophetarum, in die qua fundata est domus Domini exercituum, ut templum ædificaretur.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor dos Exércitos: Esforcem-se as vossas mãos, ó vós que nestes dias ouvistes estas palavras da boca dos profetas, que estiveram no dia em que foi posto o fundamento da casa do Senhor dos Exércitos, para que o templo fosse edificado.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος παντοκράτωρ κατισχυέτωσαν αἱ χεῖρες ὑμῶν τῶν ἀκουόντων ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ταύταις τοὺς λόγους τούτους ἐκ στόματος τῶν προφητῶν ἀφ' ἧς ἡμέρας τεθεμελίωται ὁ οἶκος κυρίου παντοκράτορος καὶ ὁ ναὸς ἀφ' οὗ ᾠκοδόμηται

text_en: For before those days there was no hire for men , neither was there hire for beasts, neither was there peace to him that came in, nor to him that went out, because of the tribulation: and I let all men go every one against his neighbour.
text_la: Siquidem ante dies illos merces hominum non erat, nec merces jumentorum erat : neque introëunti, neque exeunti erat pax præ tribulatione : et dimisi omnes homines, unumquemque contra proximum suum.
text_pt: Porque antes destes dias não tem havido salário para os homens, nem lhes davam ganhos os animais; nem havia paz para o que entrava nem para o que saía, por causa do inimigo, porque eu incitei a todos os homens, cada um contra o seu próximo.
text_el: διότι πρὸ τῶν ἡμερῶν ἐκείνων ὁ μισθὸς τῶν ἀνθρώπων οὐκ ἔσται εἰς ὄνησιν καὶ ὁ μισθὸς τῶν κτηνῶν οὐχ ὑπάρξει καὶ τῷ ἐκπορευομένῳ καὶ τῷ εἰσπορευομένῳ οὐκ ἔσται εἰρήνη ἀπὸ τῆς θλίψεως καὶ ἐξαποστελῶ πάντας τοὺς ἀνθρώπους ἕκαστον ἐπὶ τὸν πλησίον αὐτοῦ

text_en: But now I will not deal with the remnant of this people according to the former days, says the Lord of hosts .
text_la: Nunc autem non juxta dies priores ego faciam reliquiis populi hujus, dicit Dominus exercituum,
text_pt: Mas agora não serei para com o restante deste povo como nos primeiros dias, diz o Senhor dos Exércitos.
text_el: καὶ νῦν οὐ κατὰ τὰς ἡμέρας τὰς ἔμπροσθεν ἐγὼ ποιῶ τοῖς καταλοίποις τοῦ λαοῦ τούτου λέγει κύριος παντοκράτωρ

text_en: But there shall be the seed of peace: the vine shall yield her fruit, and the earth shall give her increase, and the heavens shall give their dew: and I will cause the remnant of this people to possess all these things.
text_la: sed semen pacis erit : vinea dabit fructum suum, et terra dabit germen suum, et cæli dabunt rorem suum : et possidere faciam reliquias populi hujus universa hæc.
text_pt: Porque haverá semente de prosperidade; a vide dará o seu fruto, e a terra dará a sua novidade, e os céus darão o seu orvalho; e farei que o restante deste povo herde tudo isto.
text_el: ἀλλ' ἢ δείξω εἰρήνην ἡ ἄμπελος δώσει τὸν καρπὸν αὐτῆς καὶ ἡ γῆ δώσει τὰ γενήματα αὐτῆς καὶ ὁ οὐρανὸς δώσει τὴν δρόσον αὐτοῦ καὶ κατακληρονομήσω τοῖς καταλοίποις τοῦ λαοῦ μου πάντα ταῦτα

text_en: And it shall come to pass, that as you were a curse among the Gentiles , O house of Juda , and house of Israel : so will I save you, and you shall be a blessing : fear not, let your hands be strengthened.
text_la: Et erit : sicut eratis maledictio in gentibus, domus Juda et domus Israël, sic salvabo vos, et eritis benedictio. Nolite timere; confortentur manus vestræ.
text_pt: E há de suceder, ó casa de Judá, e casa de Israel, que, assim como fostes uma maldição entre os gentios, assim vos salvarei, e sereis uma bênção; não temais, esforcem-se as vossas mãos.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ὃν τρόπον ἦτε ἐν κατάρᾳ ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν οἶκος Ιουδα καὶ οἶκος Ισραηλ οὕτως διασώσω ὑμᾶς καὶ ἔσεσθε ἐν εὐλογίᾳ θαρσεῖτε καὶ κατισχύετε ἐν ταῖς χερσὶν ὑμῶν

text_en: For thus says the Lord of hosts : As I purposed to afflict you, when your fathers had provoked me to wrath , says the Lord ,
text_la: Quia hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : Sicut cogitavi ut affligerem vos, cum ad iracundiam provocassent patres vestri me, dicit Dominus,
text_pt: Porque assim diz o Senhor dos Exércitos: Como pensei fazer-vos mal, quando vossos pais me provocaram à ira, diz o Senhor dos Exércitos, e não me arrependi,
text_el: διότι τάδε λέγει κύριος παντοκράτωρ ὃν τρόπον διενοήθην τοῦ κακῶσαι ὑμᾶς ἐν τῷ παροργίσαι με τοὺς πατέρας ὑμῶν λέγει κύριος παντοκράτωρ καὶ οὐ μετενόησα

text_en: and I had no mercy: so turning again I have thought in these days to do good to the house of Juda , and Jerusalem : fear not.
text_la: et non sum misertus : sic conversus cogitavi, in diebus istis, ut benefaciam domui Juda et Jerusalem. Nolite timere.
text_pt: Assim tornei a pensar nestes dias fazer o bem a Jerusalém e à casa de Judá; não temais.
text_el: οὕτως παρατέταγμαι καὶ διανενόημαι ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ταύταις τοῦ καλῶς ποιῆσαι τὴν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ τὸν οἶκον Ιουδα θαρσεῖτε

text_en: These then are the things, which you shall do: Speak truth every one to his neighbour; judge truth and judgment of peace in your gates.
text_la: Hæc sunt ergo verba quæ facietis : loquimini veritatem unusquisque cum proximo suo : veritatem et judicium pacis judicate in portis vestris.
text_pt: Estas são as coisas que deveis fazer: Falai a verdade cada um com o seu próximo; executai juízo de verdade e de paz nas vossas portas.
text_el: οὗτοι οἱ λόγοι οὓς ποιήσετε λαλεῖτε ἀλήθειαν ἕκαστος πρὸς τὸν πλησίον αὐτοῦ καὶ κρίμα εἰρηνικὸν κρίνατε ἐν ταῖς πύλαις ὑμῶν

text_en: And let none of you imagine evil in your hearts against his friend: and love not a false oath : for all these are the things that I hate , says the Lord .
text_la: Et unusquisque malum contra amicum suum ne cogitetis in cordibus vestris, et juramentum mendax ne diligatis : omnia enim hæc sunt quæ odi, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: E nenhum de vós pense mal no seu coração contra o seu próximo, nem ameis o juramento falso; porque todas estas são coisas que eu odeio diz o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἕκαστος τὴν κακίαν τοῦ πλησίον αὐτοῦ μὴ λογίζεσθε ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ὑμῶν καὶ ὅρκον ψευδῆ μὴ ἀγαπᾶτε διότι ταῦτα πάντα ἐμίσησα λέγει κύριος παντοκράτωρ

text_en: And the word of the Lord of hosts came to me, saying:
text_la: Et factum est verbum Domini exercituum ad me, dicens:
text_pt: E a palavra do Senhor dos Exércitos veio a mim, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κύριου παντοκράτορος πρός με λέγων

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts : The fast of the fourth month, and the fast of the fifth, and the fast of the seventh, and the fast of the tenth shall be to the house of Juda , joy , and gladness , and great solemnities: only love truth and peace.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : Jejunium quarti, et jejunium quinti, et jejunium septimi, et jejunium decimi erit domui Juda in gaudium et lætitiam et in solemnitates præclaras. Veritatem tantum et pacem diligite.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor dos Exércitos: O jejum do quarto, e o jejum do quinto, e o jejum do sétimo, e o jejum do décimo mês será para a casa de Judá gozo, alegria, e festividades solenes; amai, pois, a verdade e a paz.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος παντοκράτωρ νηστεία ἡ τετρὰς καὶ νηστεία ἡ πέμπτη καὶ νηστεία ἡ ἑβδόμη καὶ νηστεία ἡ δεκάτη ἔσονται τῷ οἴκῳ Ιουδα εἰς χαρὰν καὶ εἰς εὐφροσύνην καὶ εἰς ἑορτὰς ἀγαθὰς καὶ εὐφρανθήσεσθε καὶ τὴν ἀλήθειαν καὶ τὴν εἰρήνην ἀγαπήσατε

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts , until people come and dwell in many cities,
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, usquequo veniant populi et habitent in civitatibus multis:
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor dos Exércitos: Ainda sucederá que virão os povos e os habitantes de muitas cidades.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος παντοκράτωρ ἔτι ἥξουσιν λαοὶ πολλοὶ καὶ κατοικοῦντες πόλεις πολλάς

text_en: and the inhabitants go one to another, saying: Let us go, and entreat the face of the Lord , and let us seek the Lord of hosts : I also will go.
text_la: et vadant habitatores, unus ad alterum, dicentes : Eamus, et deprecemur faciem Domini, et quæramus Dominum exercituum : vadam etiam ego.
text_pt: E os habitantes de uma cidade irão à outra, dizendo: Vamos depressa suplicar o favor do Senhor, e buscar o Senhor dos Exércitos; eu também irei.
text_el: καὶ συνελεύσονται κατοικοῦντες πέντε πόλεις εἰς μίαν πόλιν λέγοντες πορευθῶμεν δεηθῆναι τοῦ προσώπου κυρίου καὶ ἐκζητῆσαι τὸ πρόσωπον κυρίου παντοκράτορος πορεύσομαι κἀγώ

text_en: And many peoples, and strong nations shall come to seek the Lord of hosts in Jerusalem , and to entreat the face of the Lord .
text_la: Et venient populi multi, et gentes robustæ, ad quærendum Dominum exercituum in Jerusalem, et deprecandam faciem Domini.
text_pt: Assim virão muitos povos e poderosas nações, a buscar em Jerusalém ao Senhor dos Exércitos, e a suplicar o favor do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἥξουσιν λαοὶ πολλοὶ καὶ ἔθνη πολλὰ ἐκζητῆσαι τὸ πρόσωπον κυρίου παντοκράτορος ἐν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ τοῦ ἐξιλάσκεσθαι τὸ πρόσωπον κυρίου

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts : In those days, wherein ten men of all languages of the Gentiles shall take hold, and shall hold fast the skirt of one that is a Jew , saying: We will go with you: for we have heard that God is with you.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : In diebus illis, in quibus apprehendent decem homines ex omnibus linguis gentium, et apprehendent fimbriam viri Judæi, dicentes : Ibimus vobiscum : audivimus enim quoniam Deus vobiscum est.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor dos Exércitos: Naquele dia sucederá que pegarão dez homens, de todas as línguas das nações, pegarão, sim, na orla das vestes de um judeu, dizendo: Iremos convosco, porque temos ouvido que Deus está convosco.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος παντοκράτωρ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις ἐὰν ἐπιλάβωνται δέκα ἄνδρες ἐκ πασῶν τῶν γλωσσῶν τῶν ἐθνῶν καὶ ἐπιλάβωνται τοῦ κρασπέδου ἀνδρὸς Ιουδαίου λέγοντες πορευσόμεθα μετὰ σοῦ διότι ἀκηκόαμεν ὅτι ὁ θεὸς μεθ' ὑμῶν ἐστιν

text_en: The burden of the word of the Lord in the land of Hadrach , and of Damascus the rest thereof: for the eye of man , and of all the tribes of Israel is the Lord's .
text_la: Onus verbi Domini in terra Hadrach et Damasci requiei ejus, quia Domini est oculus hominis et omnium tribuum Israël.
text_pt: O peso da palavra do SENHOR contra a terra de Hadraque, e Damasco, o seu repouso; porque o olhar do homem, e de todas as tribos de Israel, se volta para o SENHOR.
text_el: λῆμμα λόγου κυρίου ἐν γῇ Σεδραχ καὶ Δαμασκοῦ θυσία αὐτοῦ διότι κύριος ἐφορᾷ ἀνθρώπους καὶ πάσας φυλὰς τοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: Emath also in the borders thereof, and Tyre , and Sidon : for they have taken to themselves to be exceeding wise.
text_la: Emath quoque in terminis ejus, et Tyrus, et Sidon : assumpserunt quippe sibi sapientiam valde.
text_pt: E também Hamate que confina com ela, e Tiro e Sidom, ainda que sejam mais sábias.
text_el: καὶ Εμαθ ἐν τοῖς ὁρίοις αὐτῆς Τύρος καὶ Σιδών διότι ἐφρόνησαν σφόδρα

text_en: And Tyre has built herself a strong hold, and heaped together silver as earth, and gold as the mire of the streets.
text_la: Et ædificavit Tyrus munitionem suam, et coacervavit argentum quasi humum, et aurum ut lutum platearum.
text_pt: E Tiro edificou para si fortalezas, e amontoou prata como o pó, e ouro fino como a lama das ruas.
text_el: καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν Τύρος ὀχυρώματα ἑαυτῇ καὶ ἐθησαύρισεν ἀργύριον ὡς χοῦν καὶ συνήγαγεν χρυσίον ὡς πηλὸν ὁδῶν

text_en: Behold the Lord shall possess her, and shall strike her strength in the sea, and she shall be devoured with fire.
text_la: Ecce Dominus possidebit eam : et percutiet in mari fortitudinem ejus, et hæc igni devorabitur.
text_pt: Eis que o Senhor a despojará e ferirá no mar a sua força, e ela será consumida pelo fogo.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο κύριος κληρονομήσει αὐτὴν καὶ πατάξει εἰς θάλασσαν δύναμιν αὐτῆς καὶ αὕτη ἐν πυρὶ καταναλωθήσεται

text_en: Ascalon shall see, and shall fear, and Gaza , and shall be very sorrowful: and Accaron , because her hope is confounded: and the king shall perish from Gaza , and Ascalon shall not be inhabited.
text_la: Videbit Ascalon, et timebit, et Gaza, et dolebit nimis, et Accaron, quoniam confusa est spes ejus : et peribit rex de Gaza, et Ascalon non habitabitur.
text_pt: Ascalom o verá e temerá; também Gaza, e terá grande dor; igualmente Ecrom; porque a sua esperança será confundida; e o rei de Gaza perecerá, e Ascalom não será habitada.
text_el: ὄψεται Ἀσκαλὼν καὶ φοβηθήσεται καὶ Γάζα καὶ ὀδυνηθήσεται σφόδρα καὶ Ακκαρων ὅτι ᾐσχύνθη ἐπὶ τῷ παραπτώματι αὐτῆς καὶ ἀπολεῖται βασιλεὺς ἐκ Γάζης καὶ Ἀσκαλὼν οὐ μὴ κατοικηθῇ

text_en: And the divider shall sit in Azotus , and I will destroy the pride of the Philistines .
text_la: Et sedebit separator in Azoto, et disperdam superbiam Philisthinorum.
text_pt: E um bastardo habitará em Asdode, e exterminarei a soberba dos filisteus.
text_el: καὶ κατοικήσουσιν ἀλλογενεῖς ἐν Ἀζώτῳ καὶ καθελῶ ὕβριν ἀλλοφύλων

text_en: And I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth: and even he shall be left to our God , and he shall be as a governor in Juda , and Accaron as a Jebusite.
text_la: Et auferam sanguinem ejus de ore ejus, et abominationes ejus de medio dentium ejus : et relinquetur etiam ipse Deo nostro, et erit quasi dux in Juda, et Accaron quasi Jebusæus.
text_pt: E da sua boca tirarei o seu sangue, e dentre os seus dentes as suas abominações; e ele também ficará como um remanescente para o nosso Deus; e será como governador em Judá, e Ecrom como um jebuseu.
text_el: καὶ ἐξαρῶ τὸ αἷμα αὐτῶν ἐκ στόματος αὐτῶν καὶ τὰ βδελύγματα αὐτῶν ἐκ μέσου ὀδόντων αὐτῶν καὶ ὑπολειφθήσεται καὶ οὗτος τῷ θεῷ ἡμῶν καὶ ἔσονται ὡς χιλίαρχος ἐν Ιουδα καὶ Ακκαρων ὡς ὁ Ιεβουσαῖος

text_en: And I will encompass my house with them that serve me in war , going and returning, and the oppressor shall no more pass through them: for now I have seen with my eyes.
text_la: Et circumdabo domum meam ex his qui militant mihi euntes et revertentes : et non transibit super eos ultra exactor, quia nunc vidi in oculis meis.
text_pt: E acampar-me-ei ao redor da minha casa, contra o exército, para que ninguém passe, nem volte; para que não passe mais sobre eles o opressor; porque agora vi com os meus olhos.
text_el: καὶ ὑποστήσομαι τῷ οἴκῳ μου ἀνάστημα τοῦ μὴ διαπορεύεσθαι μηδὲ ἀνακάμπτειν καὶ οὐ μὴ ἐπέλθῃ ἐπ' αὐτοὺς οὐκέτι ἐξελαύνων διότι νῦν ἑώρακα ἐν τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς μου

text_en: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Sion, shout for joy , O daughter of Jerusalem : BEHOLD THY KING will come to you, the just and saviour: he is poor, and riding upon an ass, and upon a colt, the foal of an ass.
text_la: Exsulta satis, filia Sion; jubila, filia Jerusalem : ecce rex tuus veniet tibi justus, et salvator : ipse pauper, et ascendens super asinam et super pullum filium asinæ.
text_pt: Alegra-te muito, ó filha de Sião; exulta, ó filha de Jerusalém; eis que o teu rei virá a ti, justo e Salvador, pobre, e montado sobre um jumento, e sobre um jumentinho, filho de jumenta.
text_el: χαῖρε σφόδρα θύγατερ Σιων κήρυσσε θύγατερ Ιερουσαλημ ἰδοὺ ὁ βασιλεύς σου ἔρχεταί σοι δίκαιος καὶ σῴζων αὐτός πραῢς καὶ ἐπιβεβηκὼς ἐπὶ ὑποζύγιον καὶ πῶλον νέον

text_en: And I will destroy the chariot out of Ephraim, and the horse out of Jerusalem , and the bow for war shall be broken: and he shall speak peace to the Gentiles , and his power shall be from sea to sea, and from the rivers even to the end of the earth.
text_la: Et disperdam quadrigam ex Ephraim, et equum de Jerusalem, et dissipabitur arcus belli : et loquetur pacem gentibus, et potestas ejus a mari usque ad mare, et a fluminibus usque ad fines terræ.
text_pt: E de Efraim destruirei os carros, e de Jerusalém os cavalos; e o arco de guerra será destruído, e ele anunciará paz aos gentios; e o seu domínio se estenderá de mar a mar, e desde o rio até às extremidades da terra.
text_el: καὶ ἐξολεθρεύσει ἅρματα ἐξ Εφραιμ καὶ ἵππον ἐξ Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἐξολεθρευθήσεται τόξον πολεμικόν καὶ πλῆθος καὶ εἰρήνη ἐξ ἐθνῶν καὶ κατάρξει ὑδάτων ἕως θαλάσσης καὶ ποταμῶν διεκβολὰς γῆς

text_en: You also by the blood of your testament have sent forth your prisoners out of the pit, wherein is no water.
text_la: Tu quoque in sanguine testamenti tui emisisti vinctos tuos de lacu in quo non est aqua.
text_pt: Ainda quanto a ti, por causa do sangue da tua aliança, libertei os teus presos da cova em que não havia água.
text_el: καὶ σὺ ἐν αἵματι διαθήκης ἐξαπέστειλας δεσμίους σου ἐκ λάκκου οὐκ ἔχοντος ὕδωρ

text_en: Return to the strong hold, you prisoners of hope , I will render you double as I declare today.
text_la: Convertimini ad munitionem, vincti spei : hodie quoque annuntians duplicia reddam tibi.
text_pt: Voltai à fortaleza, ó presos de esperança; também hoje vos anuncio que vos restaurarei em dobro.
text_el: καθήσεσθε ἐν ὀχυρώματι δέσμιοι τῆς συναγωγῆς καὶ ἀντὶ μιᾶς ἡμέρας παροικεσίας σου διπλᾶ ἀνταποδώσω σοι

text_en: Because I have bent Juda for me as a bow, I have filled Ephraim: and I will raise up your sons, O Sion, above your sons, O Greece , and I will make you as the sword of the mighty.
text_la: Quoniam extendi mihi Judam quasi arcum : implevi Ephraim : et suscitabo filios tuos, Sion, super filios tuos, Græcia : et ponam te quasi gladium fortium.
text_pt: Porque curvei Judá para mim, enchi com Efraim o arco; suscitarei a teus filhos, ó Sião, contra os teus filhos, ó Grécia! E pôr-te-ei, ó Sião, como a espada de um poderoso.
text_el: διότι ἐνέτεινά σε Ιουδα ἐμαυτῷ τόξον ἔπλησα τὸν Εφραιμ καὶ ἐπεγερῶ τὰ τέκνα σου Σιων ἐπὶ τὰ τέκνα τῶν Ἑλλήνων καὶ ψηλαφήσω σε ὡς ῥομφαίαν μαχητοῦ

text_en: And the Lord God shall be seen over them, and his dart shall go forth as lightning: and the Lord God will sound the trumpet, and go in the whirlwind of the south.
text_la: Et Dominus Deus super eos videbitur, et exibit ut fulgur jaculum ejus : et Dominus Deus in tuba canet, et vadet in turbine austri.
text_pt: E o SENHOR será visto sobre eles, e as suas flechas sairão como o relâmpago; e o Senhor DEUS fará soar a trombeta, e irá com os redemoinhos do sul.
text_el: καὶ κύριος ἔσται ἐπ' αὐτοὺς καὶ ἐξελεύσεται ὡς ἀστραπὴ βολίς καὶ κύριος παντοκράτωρ ἐν σάλπιγγι σαλπιεῖ καὶ πορεύσεται ἐν σάλῳ ἀπειλῆς αὐτοῦ

text_en: The Lord of hosts will protect them: and they shall devour, and subdue with the stones of the sling: and drinking they shall be inebriated as it were with wine, and they shall be filled as bowls, and as the horns of the altar .
text_la: Dominus exercituum proteget eos : et devorabunt, et subjicient lapidibus fundæ : et bibentes inebriabuntur quasi a vino, et replebuntur ut phialæ, et quasi cornua altaris.
text_pt: O Senhor dos Exércitos os amparará; eles devorarão, depois que os tiverem sujeitado, as pedras da funda; também beberão e farão barulho como excitados pelo vinho; e encher-se-ão como bacias de sacrifício, como os cantos do altar.
text_el: κύριος παντοκράτωρ ὑπερασπιεῖ αὐτῶν καὶ καταναλώσουσιν αὐτοὺς καὶ καταχώσουσιν αὐτοὺς ἐν λίθοις σφενδόνης καὶ ἐκπίονται αὐτοὺς ὡς οἶνον καὶ πλήσουσιν ὡς φιάλας θυσιαστήριον

text_en: And the Lord their God will save them in that day, as the flock of his people: for holy stones shall be lifted up over his land.
text_la: Et salvabit eos Dominus Deus eorum in die illa, ut gregem populi sui, quia lapides sancti elevabuntur super terram ejus.
text_pt: E o Senhor seu Deus naquele dia os salvará, como ao rebanho do seu povo: porque como pedras de uma coroa eles resplandecerão na sua terra.
text_el: καὶ σώσει αὐτοὺς κύριος ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ὡς πρόβατα λαὸν αὐτοῦ διότι λίθοι ἅγιοι κυλίονται ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς αὐτοῦ

text_en: For what is the good thing of him, and what is his beautiful thing, but the corn of the elect , and wine springing forth virgins ?
text_la: Quid enim bonum ejus est, et quid pulchrum ejus, nisi frumentum electorum, et vinum germinans virgines?
text_pt: Porque, quão grande é a sua bondade! E quão grande é a sua formosura! O trigo fará florescer os jovens e o mosto as virgens.
text_el: ὅτι εἴ τι ἀγαθὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ εἴ τι καλὸν παρ' αὐτοῦ σῖτος νεανίσκοις καὶ οἶνος εὐωδιάζων εἰς παρθένους

text_en: Ask of the Lord rain in the latter season, and the Lord will make snows, and will give them showers of rain, to every one grass in the field.
text_la: Petite a Domino pluviam in tempore serotino, et Dominus faciet nives : et pluviam imbris dabit eis, singulis herbam in agro.
text_pt: Pedi ao SENHOR chuva no tempo da chuva serôdia, sim, ao SENHOR que faz relâmpagos; e lhes dará chuvas abundantes, e a cada um erva no campo.
text_el: αἰτεῖσθε ὑετὸν παρὰ κυρίου καθ' ὥραν πρόιμον καὶ ὄψιμον κύριος ἐποίησεν φαντασίας καὶ ὑετὸν χειμερινὸν δώσει αὐτοῖς ἑκάστῳ βοτάνην ἐν ἀγρῷ
