text_en: For the idols have spoken what was unprofitable, and the diviners have seen a lie, and the dreamers have spoken vanity: they comforted in vain: therefore they were led away as a flock: they shall be afflicted, because they have no shepherd.
text_la: Quia simulacra locuta sunt inutile, et divini viderunt mendacium : et somniatores locuti sunt frustra, vane consolabantur : idcirco abducti sunt quasi grex : affligentur, quia non est eis pastor.
text_pt: Porque os ídolos têm falado vaidade, e os adivinhos têm visto mentira, e contam sonhos falsos; com vaidade consolam, por isso seguem o seu caminho como ovelhas; estão aflitos, porque não há pastor.
text_el: διότι οἱ ἀποφθεγγόμενοι ἐλάλησαν κόπους καὶ οἱ μάντεις ὁράσεις ψευδεῖς καὶ τὰ ἐνύπνια ψευδῆ ἐλάλουν μάταια παρεκάλουν διὰ τοῦτο ἐξήρθησαν ὡς πρόβατα καὶ ἐκακώθησαν διότι οὐκ ἦν ἴασις

text_en: My wrath is kindled against the shepherds, and I will visit upon the buck goats: for the Lord of hosts has visited his flock, the house of Juda , and has made them as the horse of his glory in the battle.
text_la: Super pastores iratus est furor meus, et super hircos visitabo : quia visitavit Dominus exercituum gregem suum, domum Juda, et posuit eos quasi equum gloriæ suæ in bello.
text_pt: Contra os pastores se acendeu a minha ira, e castigarei os bodes; mas o Senhor dos Exércitos visitará o seu rebanho, a casa de Judá, e os fará como o seu majestoso cavalo na peleja.
text_el: ἐπὶ τοὺς ποιμένας παρωξύνθη ὁ θυμός μου καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς ἀμνοὺς ἐπισκέψομαι καὶ ἐπισκέψεται κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὁ παντοκράτωρ τὸ ποίμνιον αὐτοῦ τὸν οἶκον Ιουδα καὶ τάξει αὐτοὺς ὡς ἵππον εὐπρεπῆ αὐτοῦ ἐν πολέμῳ

text_en: Out of him shall come forth the corner, out of him the pin, out of him the bow of battle, out of him every exacter together.
text_la: Ex ipso angulus, ex ipso paxillus, ex ipso arcus prælii, ex ipso egredietur omnis exactor simul.
text_pt: Dele sairá a pedra de esquina, dele a estaca, dele o arco de guerra, dele juntamente sairá todo o opressor.
text_el: καὶ ἐξ αὐτοῦ ἐπέβλεψεν καὶ ἐξ αὐτοῦ ἔταξεν καὶ ἐξ αὐτοῦ τόξον ἐν θυμῷ ἐξ αὐτοῦ ἐξελεύσεται πᾶς ὁ ἐξελαύνων ἐν τῷ αὐτῷ

text_en: And they shall be as mighty men , treading under foot the mire of the ways in battle: and they shall fight, because the Lord is with them, and the riders of horses shall be confounded.
text_la: Et erunt quasi fortes conculcantes lutum viarum in prælio, et bellabunt, quia Dominus cum eis : et confundentur ascensores equorum.
text_pt: E serão como poderosos que na batalha esmagam ao inimigo no lodo das ruas; porque o Senhor estará com eles; e confundirão os que andam montados em cavalos.
text_el: καὶ ἔσονται ὡς μαχηταὶ πατοῦντες πηλὸν ἐν ταῖς ὁδοῖς ἐν πολέμῳ καὶ παρατάξονται διότι κύριος μετ' αὐτῶν καὶ καταισχυνθήσονται ἀναβάται ἵππων

text_en: And I will strengthen the house of Juda , and save the house of Joseph : and I will bring them back again, because I will have mercy on them: and they shall be as they were when I had not cast them off, for I am the Lord their God , and will hear them.
text_la: Et confortabo domum Juda, et domum Joseph salvabo : et convertam eos, quia miserebor eorum : et erunt sicut fuerunt quando non projeceram eos : ego enim Dominus Deus eorum, et exaudiam eos.
text_pt: E fortalecerei a casa de Judá, e salvarei a casa de José, e fá-los- ei voltar, porque me compadeci deles; e serão como se eu não os tivera rejeitado, porque eu sou o Senhor seu Deus, e os ouvirei.
text_el: καὶ κατισχύσω τὸν οἶκον Ιουδα καὶ τὸν οἶκον Ιωσηφ σώσω καὶ κατοικιῶ αὐτούς ὅτι ἠγάπησα αὐτούς καὶ ἔσονται ὃν τρόπον οὐκ ἀπεστρεψάμην αὐτούς διότι ἐγὼ κύριος ὁ θεὸς αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπακούσομαι αὐτοῖς

text_en: And they shall be as the valiant men of Ephraim, and their heart shall rejoice as through wine: and their children shall see, and shall rejoice, and their heart shall be joyful in the Lord .
text_la: Et erunt quasi fortes Ephraim, et lætabitur cor eorum quasi a vino : et filii eorum videbunt, et lætabuntur, et exsultabit cor eorum in Domino.
text_pt: E os de Efraim serão como um poderoso, e o seu coração se alegrará como pelo vinho; e seus filhos o verão, e se alegrarão; o seu coração se regozijará no Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἔσονται ὡς μαχηταὶ τοῦ Εφραιμ καὶ χαρήσεται ἡ καρδία αὐτῶν ὡς ἐν οἴνῳ καὶ τὰ τέκνα αὐτῶν ὄψονται καὶ εὐφρανθήσονται καὶ χαρεῖται ἡ καρδία αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τῷ κυρίῳ

text_en: I will whistle for them, and I will gather them together, because I have redeemed them: and I will multiply them as they were multiplied before.
text_la: Sibilabo eis, et congregabo illos, quia redemi eos : et multiplicabo eos sicut ante fuerant multiplicati.
text_pt: Eu lhes assobiarei, e os ajuntarei, porque eu os tenho remido; e multiplicar-se-ão como antes se tinham multiplicado.
text_el: σημανῶ αὐτοῖς καὶ εἰσδέξομαι αὐτούς διότι λυτρώσομαι αὐτούς καὶ πληθυνθήσονται καθότι ἦσαν πολλοί

text_en: And I will sow them among peoples: and from afar they shall remember me: and they shall live with their children, and shall return.
text_la: Et seminabo eos in populis, et de longe recordabuntur mei : et vivent cum filiis suis, et revertentur.
text_pt: Ainda que os espalhei por entre os povos, eles se lembrarão de mim em lugares remotos; e viverão com seus filhos, e voltarão.
text_el: καὶ σπερῶ αὐτοὺς ἐν λαοῖς καὶ οἱ μακρὰν μνησθήσονταί μου ἐκθρέψουσιν τὰ τέκνα αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπιστρέψουσιν

text_en: And I will bring them back out of the land of Egypt , and I will gather them from among the Assyrians : and will bring them to the land of Galaad, and Libanus , and place shall not be found for them.
text_la: Et reducam eos de terra Ægypti, et de Assyriis congregabo eos, et ad terram Galaad et Libani adducam eos, et non invenietur eis locus :
text_pt: Porque eu os farei voltar da terra do Egito, e os congregarei da Assíria; e trá-los-ei à terra de Gileade e do Líbano, e não se achará lugar bastante para eles.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιστρέψω αὐτοὺς ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἐξ Ἀσσυρίων εἰσδέξομαι αὐτοὺς καὶ εἰς τὴν Γαλααδῖτιν καὶ εἰς τὸν Λίβανον εἰσάξω αὐτούς καὶ οὐ μὴ ὑπολειφθῇ ἐξ αὐτῶν οὐδὲ εἷς

text_en: And he shall pass over the strait of the sea, and shall strike the waves in the sea, and all the depths of the river shall be confounded, and the pride of Assyria shall be humbled , and the sceptre of Egypt shall depart.
text_la: et transibit in maris freto, et percutiet in mari fluctus, et confundentur omnia profunda fluminis : et humiliabitur superbia Assur, et sceptrum Ægypti recedet.
text_pt: E ele passará pelo mar com angústia, e ferirá as ondas no mar, e todas as profundezas do Nilo se secarão; então será derrubada a soberba da Assíria, e o cetro do Egito se retirará.
text_el: καὶ διελεύσονται ἐν θαλάσσῃ στενῇ καὶ πατάξουσιν ἐν θαλάσσῃ κύματα καὶ ξηρανθήσεται πάντα τὰ βάθη ποταμῶν καὶ ἀφαιρεθήσεται πᾶσα ὕβρις Ἀσσυρίων καὶ σκῆπτρον Αἰγύπτου περιαιρεθήσεται

text_en: I will strengthen them in the Lord , and they shall walk in his name, says the Lord .
text_la: Confortabo eos in Domino, et in nomine ejus ambulabunt, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: E eu os fortalecerei no Senhor, e andarão no seu nome, diz o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ κατισχύσω αὐτοὺς ἐν κυρίῳ θεῷ αὐτῶν καὶ ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ κατακαυχήσονται λέγει κύριος

text_en: Open your gates, O Libanus , and let fire devour your cedars .
text_la: Aperi, Libane, portas tuas, et comedat ignis cedros tuas.
text_pt: Abre, ó Líbano, as tuas portas para que o fogo consuma os teus cedros.
text_el: διάνοιξον ὁ Λίβανος τὰς θύρας σου καὶ καταφαγέτω πῦρ τὰς κέδρους σου

text_en: Howl, you fir tree, for the cedar is fallen, for the mighty are laid waste: howl, you oaks of Basan, because the fenced forest is cut down.
text_la: Ulula, abies, quia cecidit cedrus, quoniam magnifici vastati sunt : ululate, quercus Basan, quoniam succisus est saltus munitus.
text_pt: Geme, ó cipreste, porque o cedro caiu, porque os mais poderosos são destruídos; gemei, ó carvalhos de Basã, porque o bosque forte é derrubado.
text_el: ὀλολυξάτω πίτυς διότι πέπτωκεν κέδρος ὅτι μεγάλως μεγιστᾶνες ἐταλαιπώρησαν ὀλολύξατε δρύες τῆς Βασανίτιδος ὅτι κατεσπάσθη ὁ δρυμὸς ὁ σύμφυτος

text_en: The voice of the howling of the shepherds, because their glory is laid waste: the voice of the roaring of the lions, because the pride of the Jordan is spoiled.
text_la: Vox ululatus pastorum, quia vastata est magnificentia eorum : vox rugitus leonum, quoniam vastata est superbia Jordanis.
text_pt: Voz de uivo dos pastores! porque a sua glória é destruída; voz de bramido dos filhos de leões, porque foi destruída a soberba do Jordão.
text_el: φωνὴ θρηνούντων ποιμένων ὅτι τεταλαιπώρηκεν ἡ μεγαλωσύνη αὐτῶν φωνὴ ὠρυομένων λεόντων ὅτι τεταλαιπώρηκεν τὸ φρύαγμα τοῦ Ιορδάνου

text_en: Thus says the Lord my God : Feed the flock of the slaughter,
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus meus : Pasce pecora occisionis,
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor meu Deus: Apascenta as ovelhas da matança,
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος παντοκράτωρ ποιμαίνετε τὰ πρόβατα τῆς σφαγῆς

text_en: which they that possessed, slew, and repented not, and they sold them, saying: Blessed be the Lord , we have become rich: and their shepherds spared them not.
text_la: quæ qui possederant occidebant, et non dolebant, et vendebant ea, dicentes : Benedictus Dominus! divites facti sumus : et pastores eorum non parcebant eis.
text_pt: Cujos possuidores as matam, e não se têm por culpados; e cujos vendedores dizem: Louvado seja o Senhor, porque tenho enriquecido; e os seus pastores não têm piedade delas.
text_el: ἃ οἱ κτησάμενοι κατέσφαζον καὶ οὐ μετεμέλοντο καὶ οἱ πωλοῦντες αὐτὰ ἔλεγον εὐλογητὸς κύριος καὶ πεπλουτήκαμεν καὶ οἱ ποιμένες αὐτῶν οὐκ ἔπασχον οὐδὲν ἐπ' αὐτοῖς

text_en: And I will no more spare the inhabitants of the land, says the Lord : behold I will deliver the men , every one into his neighbour's hand, and into the hand of his king: and they shall destroy the land, and I will not deliver it out of their hand.
text_la: Et ego non parcam ultra super habitantes terram, dicit Dominus : ecce ego tradam homines, unumquemque in manu proximi sui, et in manu regis sui : et concident terram, et non eruam de manu eorum.
text_pt: Certamente não terei mais piedade dos moradores desta terra, diz o Senhor; mas, eis que entregarei os homens cada um na mão do seu próximo e na mão do seu rei; eles ferirão a terra, e eu não os livrarei da sua mão.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο οὐ φείσομαι οὐκέτι ἐπὶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας τὴν γῆν λέγει κύριος καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ παραδίδωμι τοὺς ἀνθρώπους ἕκαστον εἰς χεῖρας τοῦ πλησίον αὐτοῦ καὶ εἰς χεῖρας βασιλέως αὐτοῦ καὶ κατακόψουσιν τὴν γῆν καὶ οὐ μὴ ἐξέλωμαι ἐκ χειρὸς αὐτῶν

text_en: And I will feed the flock of slaughter for this, O you poor of the flock. And I took unto me two rods, one I called Beauty, and the other I called a Cord, and I fed the flock.
text_la: Et pascam pecus occisionis propter hoc, o pauperes gregis! et assumpsi mihi duas virgas : unam vocavi Decorem, et alteram vocavi Funiculum : et pavi gregem.
text_pt: Eu, pois, apascentei as ovelhas da matança, as pobres ovelhas do rebanho. Tomei para mim duas varas: a uma chamei Graça, e à outra chamei União; e apascentei as ovelhas.
text_el: καὶ ποιμανῶ τὰ πρόβατα τῆς σφαγῆς εἰς τὴν Χαναανῖτιν καὶ λήμψομαι ἐμαυτῷ δύο ῥάβδους τὴν μίαν ἐκάλεσα Κάλλος καὶ τὴν ἑτέραν ἐκάλεσα Σχοίνισμα καὶ ποιμανῶ τὰ πρόβατα

text_en: And I cut off three shepherds in one month, and my soul was straitened in their regard: for their soul also varied in my regard.
text_la: Et succidi tres pastores in mense uno, et contracta est anima mea in eis, siquidem et anima eorum variavit in me.
text_pt: E destruí os três pastores num mês; porque a minha alma se impacientou deles, e também a alma deles se enfastiou de mim.
text_el: καὶ ἐξαρῶ τοὺς τρεῖς ποιμένας ἐν μηνὶ ἑνί καὶ βαρυνθήσεται ἡ ψυχή μου ἐπ' αὐτούς καὶ γὰρ αἱ ψυχαὶ αὐτῶν ἐπωρύοντο ἐπ' ἐμέ

text_en: And I said: I will not feed you: that which dies, let it die: and that which is cut off, let it be cut off: and let the rest devour every one the flesh of his neighbour.
text_la: Et dixi : Non pascam vos : quod moritur, moriatur, et quod succiditur, succidatur : et reliqui devorent unusquisque carnem proximi sui.
text_pt: E eu disse: Não vos apascentarei mais; o que morrer, morra; e o que for destruído, seja destruído; e as que restarem comam cada uma a carne da outra.
text_el: καὶ εἶπα οὐ ποιμανῶ ὑμᾶς τὸ ἀποθνῇσκον ἀποθνῃσκέτω καὶ τὸ ἐκλεῖπον ἐκλειπέτω καὶ τὰ κατάλοιπα κατεσθιέτωσαν ἕκαστος τὰς σάρκας τοῦ πλησίον αὐτοῦ

text_en: And I took my rod that was called Beauty, and I cut it asunder to make void my covenant, which I had made with all people.
text_la: Et tuli virgam meam quæ vocabatur Decus, et abscidi eam, ut irritum facerem fœdus meum quod percussi cum omnibus populis.
text_pt: E tomei a minha vara Graça, e a quebrei, para desfazer a minha aliança, que tinha estabelecido com todos estes povos.
text_el: καὶ λήμψομαι τὴν ῥάβδον μου τὴν καλὴν καὶ ἀπορρίψω αὐτὴν τοῦ διασκεδάσαι τὴν διαθήκην μου ἣν διεθέμην πρὸς πάντας τοὺς λαούς

text_en: And it was made void in that day: and so the poor of the flock that keep for me, understood that it is the word of the Lord .
text_la: Et in irritum deductum est in die illa : et cognoverunt sic pauperes gregis, qui custodiunt mihi, quia verbum Domini est.
text_pt: E foi desfeita naquele dia; e assim conheceram os pobres do rebanho, que me respeitavam, que isto era palavra do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ διασκεδασθήσεται ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ καὶ γνώσονται οἱ Χαναναῖοι τὰ πρόβατα τὰ φυλασσόμενα διότι λόγος κυρίου ἐστίν

text_en: And I said to them: If it be good in your eyes, bring hither my wages: and if not, be quiet. And they weighed for my wages thirty pieces of silver.
text_la: Et dixi ad eos : Si bonum est in oculis vestris, afferte mercedem meam : et si non, quiescite. Et appenderunt mercedem meam triginta argenteos.
text_pt: Porque eu lhes disse: Se parece bem aos vossos olhos, dai-me o meu salário e, se não, deixai-o. E pesaram o meu salário, trinta moedas de prata.
text_el: καὶ ἐρῶ πρὸς αὐτούς εἰ καλὸν ἐνώπιον ὑμῶν ἐστιν δότε στήσαντες τὸν μισθόν μου ἢ ἀπείπασθε καὶ ἔστησαν τὸν μισθόν μου τριάκοντα ἀργυροῦς

text_en: And the Lord said to me: Cast it to the statuary, a handsome price, that I was prized at by them. And I took the thirty pieces of silver, and I cast them into the house of the Lord to the statuary.
text_la: Et dixit Dominus ad me : Projice illud ad statuarium, decorum pretium quo appretiatus sum ab eis. Et tuli triginta argenteos, et projeci illos in domum Domini, ad statuarium.
text_pt: O Senhor, pois, disse-me: Arroja isso ao oleiro, esse belo preço em que fui avaliado por eles. E tomei as trinta moedas de prata, e as arrojei ao oleiro, na casa do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρός με κάθες αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸ χωνευτήριον καὶ σκέψαι εἰ δόκιμόν ἐστιν ὃν τρόπον ἐδοκιμάσθην ὑπὲρ αὐτῶν καὶ ἔλαβον τοὺς τριάκοντα ἀργυροῦς καὶ ἐνέβαλον αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸν οἶκον κυρίου εἰς τὸ χωνευτήριον

text_en: And I cut off my second rod that was called a Cord, that I might break the brotherhood between Juda and Israel .
text_la: Et præcidi virgam meam secundam, quæ appellabatur Funiculus, ut dissolverem germanitatem inter Judam et Israël.
text_pt: Então quebrei a minha segunda vara União, para romper a irmandade entre Judá e Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέρριψα τὴν ῥάβδον τὴν δευτέραν τὸ Σχοίνισμα τοῦ διασκεδάσαι τὴν κατάσχεσιν ἀνὰ μέσον Ιουδα καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: And the Lord said to me: Take to you yet the instruments of a foolish shepherd.
text_la: Et dixit Dominus ad me : Adhuc sume tibi vasa pastoris stulti.
text_pt: E o Senhor disse-me: Toma ainda para ti o instrumento de um pastor insensato.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρός με ἔτι λαβὲ σεαυτῷ σκεύη ποιμενικὰ ποιμένος ἀπείρου

text_en: For behold I will raise up a shepherd in the land, who shall not visit what is forsaken, nor seek what is scattered, nor heal what is broken, nor nourish that which stands, and he shall eat the flesh of the fat ones, and break their hoofs.
text_la: Quia ecce ego suscitabo pastorem in terra, qui derelicta non visitabit, dispersum non quæret, et contritum non sanabit, et id quod stat non enutriet, et carnes pinguium comedet, et ungulas eorum dissolvet.
text_pt: Porque, eis que suscitarei um pastor na terra, que não cuidará das que estão perecendo, não buscará a pequena, e não curará a ferida, nem apascentará a sã; mas comerá a carne da gorda, e lhe despedaçará as unhas.
text_el: διότι ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐξεγείρω ποιμένα ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν τὸ ἐκλιμπάνον οὐ μὴ ἐπισκέψηται καὶ τὸ διεσκορπισμένον οὐ μὴ ζητήσῃ καὶ τὸ συντετριμμένον οὐ μὴ ἰάσηται καὶ τὸ ὁλόκληρον οὐ μὴ κατευθύνῃ καὶ τὰ κρέα τῶν ἐκλεκτῶν καταφάγεται καὶ τοὺς ἀστραγάλους αὐτῶν ἐκστρέψει

text_en: O shepherd, and idol , that forsakes the flock: the sword upon his arm and upon his right eye: his arm shall quite wither away, and his right eye shall be utterly darkened.
text_la: O pastor, et idolum derelinquens gregem : gladius super brachium ejus, et super oculum dextrum ejus : brachium ejus ariditate siccabitur, et oculus dexter ejus tenebrescens obscurabitur.
text_pt: Ai do pastor inútil, que abandona o rebanho! A espada cairá sobre o seu braço e sobre o seu olho direito; e o seu braço completamente se secará, e o seu olho direito completamente se escurecerá.
text_el: ὦ οἱ ποιμαίνοντες τὰ μάταια καὶ οἱ καταλελοιπότες τὰ πρόβατα μάχαιρα ἐπὶ τοὺς βραχίονας αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν ὀφθαλμὸν τὸν δεξιὸν αὐτοῦ ὁ βραχίων αὐτοῦ ξηραινόμενος ξηρανθήσεται καὶ ὁ ὀφθαλμὸς ὁ δεξιὸς αὐτοῦ ἐκτυφλούμενος ἐκτυφλωθήσεται

text_en: The burden of the word of the Lord upon Israel . Thus says the Lord , who stretches forth the heavens , and lays the foundations of the earth, and forms the spirit of man in him:
text_la: Onus verbi Domini super Israël. Dicit Dominus extendens cælum, et fundans terram, et fingens spiritum hominis in eo :
text_pt: Peso da palavra do SENHOR sobre Israel: Fala o SENHOR, o que estende o céu, e que funda a terra, e que forma o espírito do homem dentro dele.
text_el: λῆμμα λόγου κυρίου ἐπὶ τὸν Ισραηλ λέγει κύριος ἐκτείνων οὐρανὸν καὶ θεμελιῶν γῆν καὶ πλάσσων πνεῦμα ἀνθρώπου ἐν αὐτῷ

text_en: Behold I will make Jerusalem a lintel of surfeiting to all the people round about: and Juda also shall be in the siege against Jerusalem .
text_la: Ecce ego ponam Jerusalem superliminare crapulæ omnibus populis in circuitu : sed et Juda erit in obsidione contra Jerusalem.
text_pt: Eis que eu farei de Jerusalém um copo de tremor para todos os povos em redor, e também para Judá, durante o cerco contra Jerusalém.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ τίθημι τὴν Ιερουσαλημ ὡς πρόθυρα σαλευόμενα πᾶσι τοῖς λαοῖς κύκλῳ καὶ ἐν τῇ Ιουδαίᾳ ἔσται περιοχὴ ἐπὶ Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will make Jerusalem a burdensome stone to all people: all that shall lift it up shall be rent and torn, and all the kingdoms of the earth shall be gathered together against her.
text_la: Et erit : in die illa ponam Jerusalem lapidem oneris cunctis populis : omnes qui levabunt eam concisione lacerabuntur, et colligentur adversus eam omnia regna terræ.
text_pt: E acontecerá naquele dia que farei de Jerusalém uma pedra pesada para todos os povos; todos os que a carregarem certamente serão despedaçados; e ajuntar-se-á contra ela todo o povo da terra.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ θήσομαι τὴν Ιερουσαλημ λίθον καταπατούμενον πᾶσιν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν πᾶς ὁ καταπατῶν αὐτὴν ἐμπαίζων ἐμπαίξεται καὶ ἐπισυναχθήσονται ἐπ' αὐτὴν πάντα τὰ ἔθνη τῆς γῆς

text_en: In that day, says the Lord , I will strike every horse with astonishment, and his rider with madness : and I will open my eyes upon the house of Juda , and will strike every horse of the nations with blindness.
text_la: In die illa, dicit Dominus, percutiam omnem equum in stuporem, et ascensorem ejus in amentiam : et super domum Juda aperiam oculos meos, et omnem equum populorum percutiam cæcitate.
text_pt: Naquele dia, diz o Senhor, ferirei de espanto a todos os cavalos, e de loucura os que montam neles; mas sobre a casa de Judá abrirei os meus olhos, e ferirei de cegueira a todos os cavalos dos povos.
text_el: ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ λέγει κύριος παντοκράτωρ πατάξω πάντα ἵππον ἐν ἐκστάσει καὶ τὸν ἀναβάτην αὐτοῦ ἐν παραφρονήσει ἐπὶ δὲ τὸν οἶκον Ιουδα διανοίξω τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς μου καὶ πάντας τοὺς ἵππους τῶν λαῶν πατάξω ἐν ἀποτυφλώσει

text_en: And the governors of Juda shall say in their heart: Let the inhabitants of Jerusalem be strengthened for me in the Lord of hosts , their God .
text_la: Et dicent duces Juda in corde suo : Confortentur mihi habitatores Jerusalem in Domino exercituum, Deo eorum!
text_pt: Então os governadores de Judá dirão no seu coração: Os habitantes de Jerusalém são a minha força no Senhor dos Exércitos, seu Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἐροῦσιν οἱ χιλίαρχοι Ιουδα ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις αὐτῶν εὑρήσομεν ἑαυτοῖς τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Ιερουσαλημ ἐν κυρίῳ παντοκράτορι θεῷ αὐτῶν

text_en: In that day I will make the governors of Juda like a furnace of fire amongst wood, and as a firebrand amongst hay: and they shall devour all the people round about, to the right hand, and to the left: and Jerusalem shall be inhabited again in her own place in Jerusalem .
text_la: In die illa ponam duces Juda sicut caminum ignis in lignis, et sicut facem ignis in fœno : et devorabunt ad dexteram et ad sinistram omnes populos in circuitu, et habitabitur Jerusalem rursus in loco suo in Jerusalem.
text_pt: Naquele dia porei os governadores de Judá como um braseiro ardente no meio da lenha, e como um facho de fogo entre gavelas; e à direita e à esquerda consumirão a todos os povos em redor, e Jerusalém será habitada outra vez no seu lugar, em Jerusalém;
text_el: ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ θήσομαι τοὺς χιλιάρχους Ιουδα ὡς δαλὸν πυρὸς ἐν ξύλοις καὶ ὡς λαμπάδα πυρὸς ἐν καλάμῃ καὶ καταφάγονται ἐκ δεξιῶν καὶ ἐξ εὐωνύμων πάντας τοὺς λαοὺς κυκλόθεν καὶ κατοικήσει Ιερουσαλημ ἔτι καθ' ἑαυτήν

text_en: And the Lord shall save the tabernacles of Juda , as in the beginning: that the house of David , and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem , may not boast and magnify themselves against Juda .
text_la: Et salvabit Dominus tabernacula Juda, sicut in principio, ut non magnifice glorietur domus David, et gloria habitantium Jerusalem contra Judam.
text_pt: E o Senhor salvará primeiramente as tendas de Judá, para que a glória da casa de Davi e a glória dos habitantes de Jerusalém não seja exaltada sobre Judá.
text_el: καὶ σώσει κύριος τὰ σκηνώματα Ιουδα καθὼς ἀπ' ἀρχῆς ὅπως μὴ μεγαλύνηται καύχημα οἴκου Δαυιδ καὶ ἔπαρσις τῶν κατοικούντων Ιερουσαλημ ἐπὶ τὸν Ιουδαν

text_en: In that day shall the Lord protect the inhabitants of Jerusalem , and he that has offended among them in that day shall be as David : and the house of David , as that of God , as an angel of the Lord in their sight.
text_la: In die illa proteget Dominus habitatores Jerusalem : et erit qui offenderit ex eis in die illa quasi David, et domus David quasi Dei, sicut angelus Domini in conspectu eorum.
text_pt: Naquele dia o Senhor protegerá os habitantes de Jerusalém; e o mais fraco dentre eles naquele dia será como Davi, e a casa de Davi será como Deus, como o anjo do Senhor diante deles.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ὑπερασπιεῖ κύριος ὑπὲρ τῶν κατοικούντων Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἔσται ὁ ἀσθενῶν ἐν αὐτοῖς ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ὡς οἶκος Δαυιδ ὁ δὲ οἶκος Δαυιδ ὡς οἶκος θεοῦ ὡς ἄγγελος κυρίου ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν

text_en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem .
text_la: Et erit in die illa : quæram conterere omnes gentes quæ veniunt contra Jerusalem.
text_pt: E acontecerá naquele dia, que procurarei destruir todas as nações que vierem contra Jerusalém;
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ζητήσω τοῦ ἐξᾶραι πάντα τὰ ἔθνη τὰ ἐπερχόμενα ἐπὶ Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: And I will pour out upon the house of David , and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem , the spirit of grace , and of prayers : and they shall look upon me, whom they have pierced: and they shall mourn for him as one mourns for an only son, and they shall grieve over him, as the manner is to grieve for the death of the firstborn .
text_la: Et effundam super domum David et super habitatores Jerusalem spiritum gratiæ et precum : et aspicient ad me quem confixerunt, et plangent eum planctu quasi super unigenitum, et dolebunt super eum, ut doleri solet in morte primogeniti.
text_pt: Mas sobre a casa de Davi, e sobre os habitantes de Jerusalém, derramarei o Espírito de graça e de súplicas; e olharão para mim, a quem traspassaram; e prantearão sobre ele, como quem pranteia pelo filho unigênito; e chorarão amargamente por ele, como se chora amargamente pelo primogênito.
text_el: καὶ ἐκχεῶ ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον Δαυιδ καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Ιερουσαλημ πνεῦμα χάριτος καὶ οἰκτιρμοῦ καὶ ἐπιβλέψονται πρός με ἀνθ' ὧν κατωρχήσαντο καὶ κόψονται ἐπ' αὐτὸν κοπετὸν ὡς ἐπ' ἀγαπητὸν καὶ ὀδυνηθήσονται ὀδύνην ὡς ἐπὶ πρωτοτόκῳ

text_en: In that day there shall be a great lamentation in Jerusalem like the lamentation of Adadremmon in the plain of Mageddon.
text_la: In die illa, magnus erit planctus in Jerusalem, sicut planctus Adadremmon in campo Mageddon.
text_pt: Naquele dia será grande o pranto em Jerusalém, como o pranto de Hadade-Rimom no vale de Megido.
text_el: ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ μεγαλυνθήσεται ὁ κοπετὸς ἐν Ιερουσαλημ ὡς κοπετὸς ῥοῶνος ἐν πεδίῳ ἐκκοπτομένου

text_en: And the land shall mourn: families and families apart: the families of the house of David apart, and their women apart:
text_la: Et planget terra : familiæ et familiæ seorsum : familiæ domus David seorsum, et mulieres eorum seorsum :
text_pt: E a terra pranteará, cada família à parte: a família da casa de Davi à parte, e suas mulheres à parte; e a família da casa de Natã à parte, e suas mulheres à parte;
text_el: καὶ κόψεται ἡ γῆ κατὰ φυλὰς φυλάς φυλὴ καθ' ἑαυτὴν καὶ αἱ γυναῖκες αὐτῶν καθ' ἑαυτάς φυλὴ οἶκου Δαυιδ καθ' ἑαυτὴν καὶ αἱ γυναῖκες αὐτῶν καθ' ἑαυτάς φυλὴ οἴκου Ναθαν καθ' ἑαυτὴν καὶ αἱ γυναῖκες αὐτῶν καθ' ἑαυτάς

text_en: The families of the house of Nathan apart, and their women apart: the families of the house of Levi apart, and their women apart: the families of Semei apart, and their women apart.
text_la: familiæ domus Nathan seorsum, et mulieres eorum seorsum : familiæ domus Levi seorsum, et mulieres eorum seorsum : familiæ Semei seorsum, et mulieres eorum seorsum :
text_pt: A família da casa de Levi à parte, e suas mulheres à parte; a família de Simei à parte, e suas mulheres à parte.
text_el: φυλὴ οἴκου Λευι καθ' ἑαυτὴν καὶ αἱ γυναῖκες αὐτῶν καθ' ἑαυτάς φυλὴ τοῦ Συμεων καθ' ἑαυτὴν καὶ αἱ γυναῖκες αὐτῶν καθ' ἑαυτάς

text_en: All the rest of the families , families and families apart, and their women apart.
text_la: omnes familiæ reliquæ, familiæ et familiæ seorsum, et mulieres eorum seorsum.
text_pt: Todas as mais famílias remanescentes, cada família à parte, e suas mulheres à parte.
text_el: πᾶσαι αἱ φυλαὶ αἱ ὑπολελειμμέναι φυλὴ καθ' ἑαυτὴν καὶ αἱ γυναῖκες αὐτῶν καθ' ἑαυτάς

text_en: In that day there shall be a fountain open to the house of David , and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem : for the washing of the sinner, and of the unclean woman .
text_la: In die illa erit fons patens domui David et habitantibus Jerusalem, in ablutionem peccatoris et menstruatæ.
text_pt: Naquele dia haverá uma fonte aberta para a casa de Davi, e para os habitantes de Jerusalém, para purificação do pecado e da imundícia.
text_el: ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἔσται πᾶς τόπος διανοιγόμενος ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ Δαυιδ

text_en: And it shall come to pass in that day, says the Lord of hosts , that I will destroy the names of idols out of the earth, and they shall be remembered no more: and I will take away the false prophets , and the unclean spirit out of the earth.
text_la: Et erit in die illa, dicit Dominus exercituum : disperdam nomina idolorum de terra, et non memorabuntur ultra : et pseudoprophetas, et spiritum immundum auferam de terra.
text_pt: E acontecerá naquele dia, diz o Senhor dos Exércitos, que tirarei da terra os nomes dos ídolos, e deles não haverá mais memória; e também farei sair da terra os profetas e o espírito da impureza.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ λέγει κύριος ἐξολεθρεύσω τὰ ὀνόματα τῶν εἰδώλων ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς καὶ οὐκέτι ἔσται αὐτῶν μνεία καὶ τοὺς ψευδοπροφήτας καὶ τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἀκάθαρτον ἐξαρῶ ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς

text_en: And it shall come to pass, that when any man shall prophesy any more, his father and his mother that brought him into the world, shall say to him: You shall not live: because you have spoken a lie in the name of the Lord . And his father, and his mother, his parents , shall thrust him through, when he shall prophesy .
text_la: Et erit : cum prophetaverit quispiam ultra, dicent ei pater ejus et mater ejus, qui genuerunt eum : Non vives, quia mendacium locutus es in nomine Domini : et configent eum pater ejus et mater ejus, genitores ejus, cum prophetaverit.
text_pt: E acontecerá que, quando alguém ainda profetizar, seu pai e sua mãe, que o geraram, lhe dirão: Não viverás, porque falaste mentira em nome do Senhor; e seu pai e sua mãe, que o geraram, o traspassarão quando profetizar.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐὰν προφητεύσῃ ἄνθρωπος ἔτι καὶ ἐρεῖ πρὸς αὐτὸν ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ οἱ γεννήσαντες αὐτόν οὐ ζήσῃ ὅτι ψευδῆ ἐλάλησας ἐπ' ὀνόματι κυρίου καὶ συμποδιοῦσιν αὐτὸν ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ οἱ γεννήσαντες αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ προφητεύειν αὐτόν

text_en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the prophets shall be confounded, every one by his own vision, when he shall prophesy , neither shall they be clad with a garment of sackcloth , to deceive:
text_la: Et erit : in die illa confundentur prophetæ, unusquisque ex visione sua cum prophetaverit : nec operientur pallio saccino, ut mentiantur :
text_pt: E acontecerá naquele dia que os profetas se envergonharão, cada um da sua visão, quando profetizarem; nem mais se vestirão de manto de pelos, para mentirem.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ καταισχυνθήσονται οἱ προφῆται ἕκαστος ἐκ τῆς ὁράσεως αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ προφητεύειν αὐτόν καὶ ἐνδύσονται δέρριν τριχίνην ἀνθ' ὧν ἐψεύσαντο

text_en: But he shall say: I am no prophet , I am a husbandman: for Adam is my example from my youth.
text_la: sed dicet : Non sum propheta : homo agricola ego sum, quoniam Adam exemplum meum ab adolescentia mea.
text_pt: Mas dirão: Não sou profeta, sou lavrador da terra; porque certo homem ensinou-me a guardar o gado desde a minha mocidade.
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖ οὔκ εἰμι προφήτης ἐγώ διότι ἄνθρωπος ἐργαζόμενος τὴν γῆν ἐγώ εἰμι ὅτι ἄνθρωπος ἐγέννησέν με ἐκ νεότητός μου

text_en: And they shall say to him: What are these wounds in the midst of your hands? And he shall say: With these I was wounded in the house of them that loved me.
text_la: Et dicetur ei : Quid sunt plagæ istæ in medio manuum tuarum? Et dicet : His plagatus sum in domo eorum qui diligebant me.
text_pt: E se alguém lhe disser: Que feridas são estas nas tuas mãos? Dirá ele: São feridas com que fui ferido em casa dos meus amigos.
text_el: καὶ ἐρῶ πρὸς αὐτόν τί αἱ πληγαὶ αὗται ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν χειρῶν σου καὶ ἐρεῖ ἃς ἐπλήγην ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ τῷ ἀγαπητῷ μου

text_en: Awake, O sword, against my shepherd, and against the man that cleaves to me, says the Lord of hosts : strike the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered: and I will turn my hand to the little ones.
text_la: Framea, suscitare super pastorem meum, et super virum cohærentem mihi, dicit Dominus exercituum : percute pastorem, et dispergentur oves : et convertam manum meam ad parvulos.
text_pt: Ó espada, desperta-te contra o meu pastor, e contra o homem que é o meu companheiro, diz o Senhor dos Exércitos. Fere ao pastor, e espalhar-se-ão as ovelhas; mas volverei a minha mão sobre os pequenos.
text_el: ῥομφαία ἐξεγέρθητι ἐπὶ τοὺς ποιμένας μου καὶ ἐπ' ἄνδρα πολίτην μου λέγει κύριος παντοκράτωρ πατάξατε τοὺς ποιμένας καὶ ἐκσπάσατε τὰ πρόβατα καὶ ἐπάξω τὴν χεῖρά μου ἐπὶ τοὺς ποιμένας

text_en: And there shall be in all the earth, says the Lord , two parts in it shall be scattered, and shall perish: but the third part shall be left therein.
text_la: Et erunt in omni terra, dicit Dominus : partes duæ in ea dispergentur, et deficient : et tertia pars relinquetur in ea.
text_pt: E acontecerá em toda a terra, diz o Senhor, que as duas partes dela serão extirpadas, e expirarão; mas a terceira parte restará nela.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ λέγει κύριος τὰ δύο μέρη ἐξολεθρευθήσεται καὶ ἐκλείψει τὸ δὲ τρίτον ὑπολειφθήσεται ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: And I will bring the third part through the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined: and I will try them as gold is tried. They shall call on my name , and I will hear them. I will say: You are my people: and they shall say: The Lord is my God .
text_la: Et ducam tertiam partem per ignem, et uram eos sicut uritur argentum, et probabo eos sicut probatur aurum. Ipse vocabit nomen meum, et ego exaudiam eum. Dicam : Populus meus es : et ipse dicet : Dominus Deus meus.
text_pt: E farei passar esta terceira parte pelo fogo, e a purificarei, como se purifica a prata, e a provarei, como se prova o ouro. Ela invocará o meu nome, e eu a ouvirei; direi: É meu povo; e ela dirá: O Senhor é o meu Deus.
text_el: καὶ διάξω τὸ τρίτον διὰ πυρὸς καὶ πυρώσω αὐτούς ὡς πυροῦται τὸ ἀργύριον καὶ δοκιμῶ αὐτούς ὡς δοκιμάζεται τὸ χρυσίον αὐτὸς ἐπικαλέσεται τὸ ὄνομά μου κἀγὼ ἐπακούσομαι αὐτῷ καὶ ἐρῶ λαός μου οὗτός ἐστιν καὶ αὐτὸς ἐρεῖ κύριος ὁ θεός μου

text_en: Behold the days of the Lord shall come, and your spoils shall be divided in the midst of you.
text_la: Ecce venient dies Domini, et dividentur spolia tua in medio tui.
text_pt: Eis que vem o dia do SENHOR, em que teus despojos se repartirão no meio de ti.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἡμέραι ἔρχονται τοῦ κυρίου καὶ διαμερισθήσεται τὰ σκῦλά σου ἐν σοί

text_en: And I will gather all nations to Jerusalem to battle, and the city shall be taken, and the houses shall be rifled, and the women shall be defiled: and half of the city shall go forth into captivity, and the rest of the people shall not be taken away out of the city.
text_la: Et congregabo omnes gentes ad Jerusalem in prælium : et capietur civitas, et vastabuntur domus, et mulieres violabuntur : et egredietur media pars civitatis in captivitatem, et reliquum populi non auferetur ex urbe.
text_pt: Porque eu ajuntarei todas as nações para a peleja contra Jerusalém; e a cidade será tomada, e as casas serão saqueadas, e as mulheres forçadas; e metade da cidade sairá para o cativeiro, mas o restante do povo não será extirpado da cidade.
text_el: καὶ ἐπισυνάξω πάντα τὰ ἔθνη ἐπὶ Ιερουσαλημ εἰς πόλεμον καὶ ἁλώσεται ἡ πόλις καὶ διαρπαγήσονται αἱ οἰκίαι καὶ αἱ γυναῖκες μολυνθήσονται καὶ ἐξελεύσεται τὸ ἥμισυ τῆς πόλεως ἐν αἰχμαλωσίᾳ οἱ δὲ κατάλοιποι τοῦ λαοῦ μου οὐ μὴ ἐξολεθρευθῶσιν ἐκ τῆς πόλεως

text_en: Then the Lord shall go forth, and shall fight against those nations, as when he fought in the day of battle.
text_la: Et egredietur Dominus, et præliabitur contra gentes illas, sicut præliatus est in die certaminis.
text_pt: E o Senhor sairá, e pelejará contra estas nações, como pele- jou, sim, no dia da batalha.
text_el: καὶ ἐξελεύσεται κύριος καὶ παρατάξεται ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ἐκείνοις καθὼς ἡμέρα παρατάξεως αὐτοῦ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ πολέμου

text_en: And his feet shall stand in that day upon the mount of Olives , which is over against Jerusalem towards the east: and the mount of Olives shall be divided in the midst thereof to the east, and to the west with a very great opening, and half of the mountain shall be separated to the north, and half thereof to the south.
text_la: Et stabunt pedes ejus in die illa super montem Olivarum, qui est contra Jerusalem ad orientem : et scindetur mons Olivarum ex media parte sui ad orientem et ad occidentem, prærupto grandi valde : et separabitur medium montis ad aquilonem, et medium ejus ad meridiem.
text_pt: E naquele dia estarão os seus pés sobre o monte das Oliveiras, que está defronte de Jerusalém para o oriente; e o monte das Oliveiras será fendido pelo meio, para o oriente e para o ocidente, e haverá um vale muito grande; e metade do monte se apartará para o norte, e a outra metade dele para o sul.
text_el: καὶ στήσονται οἱ πόδες αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἐπὶ τὸ ὄρος τῶν ἐλαιῶν τὸ κατέναντι Ιερουσαλημ ἐξ ἀνατολῶν καὶ σχισθήσεται τὸ ὄρος τῶν ἐλαιῶν τὸ ἥμισυ αὐτοῦ πρὸς ἀνατολὰς καὶ τὸ ἥμισυ αὐτοῦ πρὸς θάλασσαν χάος μέγα σφόδρα καὶ κλινεῖ τὸ ἥμισυ τοῦ ὄρους πρὸς βορρᾶν καὶ τὸ ἥμισυ αὐτοῦ πρὸς νότον

text_en: And you shall flee to the valley of those mountains, for the valley of the mountains shall be joined even to the next, and you shall flee as you fled from the face of the earthquake in the days of Ozias king of Juda : and the Lord my God shall come, and all the saints with him.
text_la: Et fugietis ad vallem montium eorum, quoniam conjungetur vallis montium usque ad proximum : et fugietis sicut fugistis a facie terræmotus in diebus Oziæ regis Juda : et veniet Dominus Deus meus, omnesque sancti cum eo.
text_pt: E fugireis pelo vale dos meus montes, pois o vale dos montes chegará até Azel; e fugireis assim como fugistes de diante do terremoto nos dias de Uzias, rei de Judá. Então virá o Senhor meu Deus, e todos os santos contigo.
text_el: καὶ ἐμφραχθήσεται φάραγξ ὀρέων μου καὶ ἐγκολληθήσεται φάραγξ ὀρέων ἕως Ιασολ καὶ ἐμφραχθήσεται καθὼς ἐνεφράγη ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις τοῦ σεισμοῦ ἐν ἡμέραις Οζιου βασιλέως Ιουδα καὶ ἥξει κύριος ὁ θεός μου καὶ πάντες οἱ ἅγιοι μετ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that there shall be no light, but cold and frost.
text_la: Et erit in die illa : non erit lux, sed frigus et gelu.
text_pt: E acontecerá naquele dia, que não haverá preciosa luz, nem espessa escuridão.
text_el: ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ οὐκ ἔσται φῶς καὶ ψῦχος καὶ πάγος

text_en: And there shall be one day, which is known to the Lord , not day nor night: and in the time of the evening there shall be light:
text_la: Et erit dies una quæ nota est Domino, non dies neque nox : et in tempore vesperi erit lux.
text_pt: Mas será um dia conhecido do Senhor; nem dia nem noite será; mas acontecerá que ao cair da tarde haverá luz.
text_el: ἔσται μίαν ἡμέραν καὶ ἡ ἡμέρα ἐκείνη γνωστὴ τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ οὐχ ἡμέρα καὶ οὐ νύξ καὶ πρὸς ἑσπέραν ἔσται φῶς

text_en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that living waters shall go out from Jerusalem : half of them to the east sea, and half of them to the last sea: they shall be in summer and in winter.
text_la: Et erit in die illa : exibunt aquæ vivæ de Jerusalem : medium earum ad mare orientale, et medium earum ad mare novissimum : in æstate et in hieme erunt.
text_pt: Naquele dia também acontecerá que sairão de Jerusalém águas vivas, metade delas para o mar oriental, e metade delas para o mar ocidental; no verão e no inverno sucederá isto.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἐξελεύσεται ὕδωρ ζῶν ἐξ Ιερουσαλημ τὸ ἥμισυ αὐτοῦ εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν τὴν πρώτην καὶ τὸ ἥμισυ αὐτοῦ εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν τὴν ἐσχάτην καὶ ἐν θέρει καὶ ἐν ἔαρι ἔσται οὕτως

text_en: And the Lord shall be king over all the earth: in that day there shall be one Lord , and his name shall be one.
text_la: Et erit Dominus rex super omnem terram : in die illa erit Dominus unus, et erit nomen ejus unum.
text_pt: E o Senhor será rei sobre toda a terra; naquele dia um será o Senhor, e um será o seu nome.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται κύριος εἰς βασιλέα ἐπὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἔσται κύριος εἷς καὶ τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἕν

text_en: And all the land shall return even to the desert , from the hill to Remmon to the south of Jerusalem : and she shall be exalted, and shall dwell in her own place, from the gate of Benjamin even to the place of the former gate, and even to the gate of the corners: and from the tower of Hananeel even to the king's winepresses.
text_la: Et revertetur omnis terra usque ad desertum, de colle Remmon ad austrum Jerusalem : et exaltabitur, et habitabit in loco suo, a porta Benjamin usque ad locum portæ prioris, et usque ad portam angulorum, et a turre Hananeel usque ad torcularia regis.
text_pt: Toda a terra em redor se tornará em planície, desde Geba até Rimom, ao sul de Jerusalém, e ela será exaltada, e habitada no seu lugar, desde a porta de Benjamim até ao lugar da primeira porta, até à porta da esquina, e desde a torre de Hananeel até aos lagares do rei.
text_el: κυκλῶν πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν καὶ τὴν ἔρημον ἀπὸ Γαβε ἕως Ρεμμων κατὰ νότον Ιερουσαλημ Ραμα δὲ ἐπὶ τόπου μενεῖ ἀπὸ τῆς πύλης Βενιαμιν ἕως τοῦ τόπου τῆς πύλης τῆς πρώτης ἕως τῆς πύλης τῶν γωνιῶν καὶ ἕως τοῦ πύργου Ανανεηλ ἕως τῶν ὑποληνίων τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: And people shall dwell in it, and there shall be no more an anathema : but Jerusalem shall sit secure.
text_la: Et habitabunt in ea, et anathema non erit amplius, sed sedebit Jerusalem secura.
text_pt: E habitarão nela, e não haverá mais destruição, porque Jerusalém habitará segura.
text_el: κατοικήσουσιν ἐν αὐτῇ καὶ οὐκ ἔσται ἀνάθεμα ἔτι καὶ κατοικήσει Ιερουσαλημ πεποιθότως

text_en: And this shall be the plague wherewith the Lord shall strike all nations that have fought against Jerusalem : the flesh of every one shall consume away while they stand upon their feet, and their eyes shall consume away in their holes, and their tongue shall consume away in their mouth.
text_la: Et hæc erit plaga qua percutiet Dominus omnes gentes quæ pugnaverunt adversus Jerusalem : tabescet caro uniuscujusque stantis super pedes suos : et oculi ejus contabescent in foraminibus suis, et lingua eorum contabescet in ore suo.
text_pt: E esta será a praga com que o Senhor ferirá a todos os povos que guerrearam contra Jerusalém: a sua carne apodrecerá, estando eles em pé, e lhes apodrecerão os olhos nas suas órbitas, e a língua lhes apodrecerá na sua boca.
text_el: καὶ αὕτη ἔσται ἡ πτῶσις ἣν κόψει κύριος πάντας τοὺς λαούς ὅσοι ἐπεστράτευσαν ἐπὶ Ιερουσαλημ τακήσονται αἱ σάρκες αὐτῶν ἑστηκότων αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τοὺς πόδας αὐτῶν καὶ οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτῶν ῥυήσονται ἐκ τῶν ὀπῶν αὐτῶν καὶ ἡ γλῶσσα αὐτῶν τακήσεται ἐν τῷ στόματι αὐτῶν

text_en: In that day there shall be a great tumult from the Lord among them: and a man shall take the hand of his neighbour, and his hand shall be clasped upon his neighbour's hand.
text_la: In die illa erit tumultus Domini magnus in eis : et apprehendet vir manum proximi sui, et conseretur manus ejus super manum proximi sui.
text_pt: Naquele dia também acontecerá que haverá da parte do Senhor uma grande perturbação entre eles; porque cada um pegará na mão do seu próximo, e cada um levantará a mão contra o seu próximo.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἔκστασις κυρίου ἐπ' αὐτοὺς μεγάλη καὶ ἐπιλήμψονται ἕκαστος τῆς χειρὸς τοῦ πλησίον αὐτοῦ καὶ συμπλακήσεται ἡ χεὶρ αὐτοῦ πρὸς χεῖρα τοῦ πλησίον αὐτοῦ

text_en: And even Juda shall fight against Jerusalem : and the riches of all nations round about shall be gathered together, gold, and silver, and garments in great abundance.
text_la: Sed et Judas pugnabit adversus Jerusalem : et congregabuntur divitiæ omnium gentium in circuitu, aurum, et argentum, et vestes multæ satis.
text_pt: E também Judá pelejará em Jerusalém, e as riquezas de todos os gentios serão ajuntadas ao redor, ouro e prata e roupas em grande abundância.
text_el: καὶ ὁ Ιουδας παρατάξεται ἐν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ συνάξει τὴν ἰσχὺν πάντων τῶν λαῶν κυκλόθεν χρυσίον καὶ ἀργύριον καὶ ἱματισμὸν εἰς πλῆθος σφόδρα

text_en: And the destruction of the horse, and of the mule, and of the camel, and of the ass, and of all the beasts, that shall be in those tents, shall be like this destruction.
text_la: Et sic erit ruina equi, et muli, et cameli, et asini, et omnium jumentorum quæ fuerint in castris illis, sicut ruina hæc.
text_pt: Assim será também a praga dos cavalos, dos mulos, dos camelos e dos jumentos e de todos os animais que estiverem naqueles arraiais, como foi esta praga.
text_el: καὶ αὕτη ἔσται ἡ πτῶσις τῶν ἵππων καὶ τῶν ἡμιόνων καὶ τῶν καμήλων καὶ τῶν ὄνων καὶ πάντων τῶν κτηνῶν τῶν ὄντων ἐν ταῖς παρεμβολαῖς ἐκείναις κατὰ τὴν πτῶσιν ταύτην

text_en: And all they that shall be left of all nations that came against Jerusalem , shall go up from year to year, to adore the King, the Lord of hosts , and to keep the feast of tabernacles.
text_la: Et omnes qui reliqui fuerint de universis gentibus quæ venerunt contra Jerusalem, ascendent ab anno in annum ut adorent regem, Dominum exercituum, et celebrent festivitatem tabernaculorum.
text_pt: E acontecerá que, todos os que restarem de todas as nações que vieram contra Jerusalém, subirão de ano em ano para adorar o Rei, o Senhor dos Exércitos, e para celebrarem a festa dos tabernáculos.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ὅσοι ἐὰν καταλειφθῶσιν ἐκ πάντων τῶν ἐθνῶν τῶν ἐλθόντων ἐπὶ Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἀναβήσονται κατ' ἐνιαυτὸν τοῦ προσκυνῆσαι τῷ βασιλεῖ κυρίῳ παντοκράτορι καὶ τοῦ ἑορτάζειν τὴν ἑορτὴν τῆς σκηνοπηγίας

text_en: And it shall come to pass, that he that shall not go up of the families of the land to Jerusalem , to adore the King, the Lord of hosts , there shall be no rain upon them.
text_la: Et erit : qui non ascenderit de familiis terræ ad Jerusalem ut adoret regem, Dominum exercituum, non erit super eos imber.
text_pt: E acontecerá que, se alguma das famílias da terra não subir a Jerusalém, para adorar o Rei, o Senhor dos Exércitos, não virá sobre ela a chuva.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ὅσοι ἐὰν μὴ ἀναβῶσιν ἐκ πασῶν τῶν φυλῶν τῆς γῆς εἰς Ιερουσαλημ τοῦ προσκυνῆσαι τῷ βασιλεῖ κυρίῳ παντοκράτορι καὶ οὗτοι ἐκείνοις προστεθήσονται

text_en: And if the family of Egypt go not up nor come: neither shall it be upon them, but there shall be destruction wherewith the Lord will strike all nations that will not go up to keep the feast of tabernacles.
text_la: Quod etsi familia Ægypti non ascenderit et non venerit, nec super eos erit : sed erit ruina, qua percutiet Dominus omnes gentes quæ non ascenderint ad celebrandam festivitatem tabernaculorum.
text_pt: E, se a família dos egípcios não subir, nem vier, não virá sobre ela a chuva; virá sobre eles a praga com que o Senhor ferirá os gentios que não subirem a celebrar a festa dos tabernáculos.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ φυλὴ Αἰγύπτου μὴ ἀναβῇ μηδὲ ἔλθῃ ἐκεῖ καὶ ἐπὶ τούτοις ἔσται ἡ πτῶσις ἣν πατάξει κύριος πάντα τὰ ἔθνη ὅσα ἐὰν μὴ ἀναβῇ τοῦ ἑορτάσαι τὴν ἑορτὴν τῆς σκηνοπηγίας

text_en: This shall be the sin of Egypt , and this the sin of all nations, that will not go up to keep the feast of tabernacles.
text_la: Hoc erit peccatum Ægypti, et hoc peccatum omnium gentium quæ non ascenderint ad celebrandam festivitatem tabernaculorum.
text_pt: Este será o castigo do pecado dos egípcios e o castigo do pecado de todas as nações que não subirem a celebrar a festa dos tabernáculos.
text_el: αὕτη ἔσται ἡ ἁμαρτία Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἡ ἁμαρτία πάντων τῶν ἐθνῶν ὅσα ἂν μὴ ἀναβῇ τοῦ ἑορτάσαι τὴν ἑορτὴν τῆς σκηνοπηγίας

text_en: In that day that which is upon the bridle of the horse shall be holy to the Lord : and the caldrons in the house of the Lord shall be as the phials before the altar .
text_la: In die illa, erit quod super frenum equi est, sanctum Domino : et erunt lebetes in domo Domini quasi phialæ coram altari.
text_pt: Naquele dia será gravado sobre as campainhas dos cavalos: SANTIDADE AO SENHOR; e as panelas na casa do SENHOR serão como as bacias diante do altar.
text_el: ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἔσται τὸ ἐπὶ τὸν χαλινὸν τοῦ ἵππου ἅγιον τῷ κυρίῳ παντοκράτορι καὶ ἔσονται οἱ λέβητες οἱ ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ κυρίου ὡς φιάλαι πρὸ προσώπου τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου

text_en: And every caldron in Jerusalem and Juda shall be sanctified to the Lord of hosts : and all that sacrifice shall come, and take of them, and shall seethe in them: and the merchant shall be no more in the house of the Lord of hosts in that day.
text_la: Et erit omnis lebes in Jerusalem et in Juda sanctificatus Domino exercituum : et venient omnes immolantes, et sument ex eis, et coquent in eis : et non erit mercator ultra in domo Domini exercituum in die illo.
text_pt: E todas as panelas em Jerusalém e Judá serão consagradas ao Senhor dos Exércitos, e todos os que sacrificarem virão, e delas tomarão, e nelas cozerão. E naquele dia não haverá mais cananeu na casa do Senhor dos Exércitos.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται πᾶς λέβης ἐν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἐν τῷ Ιουδα ἅγιον τῷ κυρίῳ παντοκράτορι καὶ ἥξουσιν πάντες οἱ θυσιάζοντες καὶ λήμψονται ἐξ αὐτῶν καὶ ἑψήσουσιν ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ οὐκ ἔσται Χαναναῖος οὐκέτι ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ κυρίου παντοκράτορος ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ
